Trotz der versenkten Tonnage der Alliierten konnten die deutschen U-Boote weder den feindlichen Nachschub wirksam unterbinden noch irgendein strategisches Ziel erreichen. History is filled with tales of great minds coming together, and collaborating, to achieve incredible things. It's also full of idiots working together to create an unholy mess, and people forming partnerships for decidedly sinister reasons, welcome to Horrible Histories' Chaotic Collabs. The Black Hand Gang worked together to assassinate Archduke Franz Ferdinand of Austria, and thus trigger a chain of events that led to World War One.
Revolting space travel, evolving cows, pet mushrooms, and Einstein watches a car on a trampoline.
The guinea pigs find who's been painting bananas on vans, and a polar bear tries acting.
Callum levels up a challenge with a massive inflatable assault course in the back garden. Callum will decide who is the bounciest bro and who is just full of hot air.
Donut dares, haunted gym bikes, motivational mayhem and personal bests. Will they tap out?
Match of the Day is coming to film the Fantastics, but Jaz is injured. Can she get on TV?
When The Krusty Krab runs out of mustard, Mr Krabs sends SpongeBob, Patrick and Squidward to dig up some more.
Mr. Krabs hires Squidward to baby-sit Pearl for the night, but she just wants to sneak out to a cool teen party.
One of the sardine crew members decides to leave the submarine behind.
Jim discovers that a secret night captain has been running the submarine.
Wizz is aging, but way too rapidly for his liking. At the rate in which he is growing, he will be 100 years old very soon.

Just as Agent Paxton, the Scotland Yard pigeon, is about to share an important piece of information with his boss, Detective McFlare, they are attacked by a small, elusive, mysterious adversary with Ninja combat techniques.
A fidget spinner, lightbulb, microwave and mobile phone are among the items getting the Sketchy treatment!
Duck's job as an art teacher leads to Frog striking a pose for the class.
Duck is working in a lovely cosy ski lodge, until Frog turns up and ruins everything.
Tom must keep his mum distracted while Jun, Alex and D'Angelo use a new dragon to close off a cave leading to the Crystal Realm.
Big trouble threatens the big city, it's up to Ash, Pikachu, and their friends to stop it when a group of five Mythical Pokémon Genesects' nest threatens the city's power supply.

A military convoy has an accident while transporting top-secret material. In the impact, a technological sphere flies out and rolls over to Grizzy, who was gathering berries.
When the floor ends up covered in gum on the day of a big bubble blowing contest, Sugar decides she might help herself win by helping her friends get stuck to the floor.
When all their classmates are replaced with well-behaved Australian doppelgängers in a school exchange programme, Lightning and Cody start getting suspicious.
In the town of Artazon, Liko, Roy and top trainer Nemona meet up with the artist Brassius, who recounts his dark encounter with the black Rayquaza.
The Scooby Gang travels the 21st century in their Mystery Machine. A simple trip to the mall turns into another mystery when toys come to life.

Baby Jake and the Hamsternauts go on a space adventure and enjoy jumping.

Bing wants Flop to read him his favourite book as he has his bath, but Bing joins in with the story too enthusiastically. Flop suggests they finish the story in bed as books don't like baths. When the book falls into the bath, Bing is heartbroken, but Flop helps him to understand that even though the book is wet the story isn't.
Tralala and Batty use clever mathematics to get enough cake for the guests at their party.
The gang sing about the importance of family and friends in this heartfelt ballad.

Cherry dreams of soaring through the sky. The Piggy Builders build her a plane, but she jumps in without learning how to fly. Taking off is easy, but landing proves a disaster which makes Cherry think that flying is not for her.
Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Coconut getting his moment in the limelight with his sea shanty Oh, the Big Waves, if he manages to overcome a little stage fright.
Searching for a G.O Star at the Leaning Tower of Pisa, Kym and Lars must stop Glitch from damaging the famous landmark and use the G.O Fix to save the day.
Mojo and Bo have to carry Jackson's big blue 'chicken' Ludwig (who definitely isn't a chicken) to the country fair. But the easily-startled bird gets away from them, and the chase is on.
When Safari Park is closed for the day, Koko, Wilson, and Brewster give Piper a surprise tour and discover all the exotic wildlife present outside the park.

Sula, Pando, Flop and Padget all have a knack, a special thing that only they can do. Bing is frustrated when all his own knacks are easy for everyone else to do too. When Pando accidentally hurts Bing's ear they are all in for a surprise, as Bing discovers he does have a knack that no-one else can do.

It's vaccination day! Bing knows it might hurt a little, but he is looking forward to the special shiny Hoppity Voosh sticker he will get from Doctor Molly. Bing is brave, but when he goes to get his sticker after his vaccination, he finds out that there are none left! Bing is upset, but then Pando mistakes Bing's disappointment for pain, and Doctor Bing has to help.
Meet Duggee, a big lovable dog who runs a club for pre-schoolers that inspires children to have fun, be energetic, and - most of all - to do things!
When the squirrels upset the mole by being noisy, Duggee suggests ways that they can all live underground peacefully.
Mum plays the animal game on Bingo's back. She pretends Bingo's back is a big field and various animals walk, jump and dart across it, making Bingo laugh.
When the Grimbots build their own Easter Island statue, it collapses and threatens the ancient Moai statues.
Peter volunteers to take Mrs Tiggy-Winkle home in time for her winter hibernation, but little does he know how much trouble a sleepy hedgehog can be!
The Octonauts head to the kelp forest to visit Shellington's sister, Pearl, and her newborn son Periwinkle – only to find the forest endangered by an infestation of kelp-eating urchins!
When Vida's vet bag goes missing, it's up to her and her Sweetwoodian friends to track it down. Not only do they find it, but they also discover a hermit crab in need of a new home.
Cap'n Gail's tall tale of a nine-legged octopus in Lake Swoppiton has everyone panicking. But Mojo and Bo wonder: is the story real or is Cap'n Gail up to something?

Oi, oi. It is my Treetops Challenge. Are you ready to climb this sky-high challenge all the way to the canopy? We will be adventuring low to high, starting with climbers to squats, then star jumps, and finally, the Activate.
Justin and his friend head to a marina for lots of boating fun. Meanwhile, Mr Tumble has ordered a new inflatable boat to take fishing. What could possibly go wrong?
Dad chides Bluey for not minding her manners at the dinner table, but when Bluey gets a hold of a magical asparagus stick, she proves that everyone has a wild side.
Bluey is unable to get to sleep, so Mum reads her one last story. Unicorse, the most annoying hand puppet in the world, interrupts them, and Bluey tries to reform it.
When the Squirrels find Duggee playing the saxophone, they want to have a go too. Several pots, balloons, tins, water and tubes later, and the squirrels are making music. And boy, are they loud.
When Egg, the cheeky little chick, goes on the run again, Duggee whistles to get him back. Hang on a minute Duggee, what was that noise?
Boom hasn't been sleeping and is so tired he crashes into a tree. Zog and the doctors try everything to get him back to sleep.
When the Emperor Penguin visits the berg, he discovers Pancake is a long-lost Prince. Pancake learns how to act royal, but all the attention goes to his head.
Rafi's shadow wish goes wrong and causes havoc at a sleepover with Ruby.
Weasy ditches the ducklings to become a comic book hero with a bat sidekick.
Team Spidey helps the city when Zola becomes a superhero like Iron Man and decides to do his own kinds of heroics. Aunt May's birthday balloon ride strands her, Spidey and Gobby on an island.
The Octonauts find a threatened tree that must be moved, but the creatures inside disagree.
Mum sets up the playroom as an escape room for the kids, but when Pranksy locks the door, the spies must solve all the puzzles to get out.
Ginger and the baby Pea-Rexes get caught in the middle of out-of-control rolling Coconutdons and tail-swatting Pineapplesaurus.
Evil Pea thinks the Veggies won't like it when she covers the supermarket in ice, but instead they have the best snow day ever, so she creates a giant snowball to ruin their fun.

Antiques expert Ann Teak gets more than she bargained for when she examines a Georgian dress. Newsreader Arthur Sleep reports that he had his face painted at the village fête, before realising he's forgotten to wash the paint off.
Following Dodge at Pup School, a place full of mishaps and mayhem. Dodge and his pup pals turn school days into adventures with singing, silliness, and occasional squeaky toys.

Brunsli Biscuits are a traditional Swiss recipe that taste and smell very Christmassy. Tilly adds spices such as ground nutmeg to her chocolate biscuit dough, before cutting it into snowflake shapes. With the help of her sister, Tilly decorates her biscuits with a beautiful white icing. Tilly's table has lots of Christmas decorations on it as well as the traditional flower of Switzerland, edelweiss. Let's hope Tilly's friends enjoy the taste of the biscuits!
The Buds follow Chatterpot's slimy trail to explore the world of slugs and snails.
A dusty, old box makes Rebecca sneeze! Murphy dreams up some make ideas to help reveal what is inside, including a tissue box monster and a flamingo sock puppet.
After diving in Balamory Bay, PC Plum dreams of taking the nursery children underwater.
Ding-dong, there is somebody at the door. It is delivery Chipmunk with a parcel for Duggee, but why is it wrapped up like a present? Maybe it is Duggee's birthday.
Tweak does her very best to help her friend Sandy the sea turtle evade the hungry jaws of a tiger shark.
When Popcorn is afraid to enter the spooky corn maze at the carnival, Vida helps him conquer his fear of the unknown by asking lots of questions before trying something new.

Ubercorn, Glitch and the Go Jetters all head to the Dwarkadhish Temple in Dwarka, India, for the Holi Festival of Colour. This Hindu celebration involves people throwing a colourful powder called gulal all over one another.
Whilst Dad searches for a faulty wire, Cosima and Big Lizard play tag in the ship and accidentally break Big Lizard's bath bed! Where will he sleep now? And where's that pesky wire?
Stripes worries that the Sundial Stage isn't loud enough when his guitar hero comes to play a gig. With Yukee's help, Stripes is determined to turn the volume up to 11, but is that too loud?
On a rainy day, the Froglets create a shadow show for Bertie and their puppet friends.
Today, Mr Tumble is looking for a hobby. Meanwhile, Justin meets a friend who plays Powerchair football as his hobby.
Ching and the Fact Pack discover the many uses of bamboo, from building materials to cooking.
It's the Balamory dance away, but Ava is struggling to dance like anyone else. Inspired by the Harbour Master, Ava invents her own moves, which everyone at the nursery soon follows.
Winton doesn't want anyone to know about his tummy troubles but Gadabout struggles to keep the news to himself.
Mum reminisces about Bluey and Judo as babies. Bluey learnt to roll over first, but Judo was the first to crawl, so then it became a race to see who was going to walk first.

Mae and Bee accidentally find a giant strawberry while exploring, but they quickly realize they may have bitten off much more than they can chew as they hilariously struggle to manage the massive fruit during their latest chaotic adventure.
Sid wants Tralala to wear her coat outside, but won't the coat get cold too?
Rafi's wish to do it all causes chaos, teaching her one task at a time works best.
With help from some kittens, Nick and the Popcasters put on a big concert at the old town hall for two very special mums.
Love Monster is finding it hard to think of something new to do on Do Something New Day, so he heads to Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny's house to see if she has any ideas.
Topsy and Tim are growing out of their old, matching twin clothes, so Mummy buys them new jeans. Topsy is delighted with her new jeans - they have butterfly designs all over them.
Dylan imagines he is a crossing guard.
Keith wants to have a pirate adventure, so the Piggies build him a wheeled ship. Together, they sail across Fine Forest in search of treasure. When Wilf hears about their hunt, he joins the crew.

Without her ukulele, Yukee struggles to come up with a tune for the words she wrote for a new song. Her friends try to help, but none of their styles fit. Can the piano Sonny and Paulie the peacock bring to the Sunhouse be the answer?
Donna and Ashley go on a musical adventure and discover Daffodils by William Wordsworth, and A Musical Instrument by Elizabeth Barrett Browning.
When an outbreak of lupine lurgy causes the doctors' patients to howl like wolves, Zog races to treat as many creatures as he can, with chaotic results.
Whiff says he needs help, so Mac invents Robo Whiff: a super-efficient robot roadie. But things soon start to go wrong as Whiff's pushy robotic twin starts to take over the band.

JoJo needs to find different-coloured leaves to complete her nature tick-book, but she can't find a green one. What will she do? Luckily, Gran Gran has a Gran Gran Plan that involves a special leaf rubbing!
Baba helps rescue a baby seagull caught up in fishing twine on the beach, proving that he is now as capable as his older sister and friends.

Lola is horrified because she has her first ever wobbly tooth, and she does not ever want it to fall out. She doesn't want a big gap in her teeth even if Charlie does say that she'll grow another, stronger one.

Mr Onion finds a paper cone in the curiosity box and discovers it is good for 'loud talking'. In Storyland, Mr Onion arrives at a Sleepy Castle where everybody has been asleep for a hundred years. How might Mr Onion use his paper cone?
MeMo and BaBa help the Yummies achieve their dream - to fly.

The Tombliboos are indoors playing with their bricks, and they decide to make three towers. Makka Pakka is making piles of stones, but he needs another one to make three piles of three stones. Here comes Upsy Daisy, and she has a present for Makka Pakka, a stone which she found in her bed.

We search the world to bring you the most innovative home and garden must-haves. So, sit back, relax and discover something new.

Delve into amazing chocolate history, modern-day Willy Wonkas, eye-popping factory tours, rare ingredients and luxury treats, as well as the everyday chocolate favourites.

An exclusive factory tour of Kim's, the biggest exporter of Belgian chocolate to supermarkets around the world, chocolate glamping in Slovenia, and the secrets of making the Mars Malteaster Bunny revealed.

Dwayne veranstaltet auf einem Kreuzfahrtschiff eine wilde Party. Randall hat unterdessen weniger zu lachen, er erkrankt an der gefährlichen Pollenallergie.

Das gibt es nur im Big Apple und in dieser Animationsserie: Ein Zombie, ein Fantasy-Freak und ein ganz normaler Sozialarbeiter treffen in New York zusammen. Mark Lilly hat es nicht leicht. Sein Mitbewohner ist ein Untoter und die Chefin ein Dämon.

In vielen Fällen machen die sozialen Medien Menschen das Leben schwer. Ständig empfängt man Nachrichten aus der Familien-Whatsapp-Gruppe oder wird mit Videos konfrontiert. In der Sendung geht es darum, ob es überhaupt noch ohne "Social Media" geht.

Kyle, Mr. Garrison und Mr. Slave reisen nach New York, um den neuen metrosexuellen Wahn zu beenden. Dort erfahren sie, dass die angeblich schwulen Moderatoren in Wahrheit "Crab-People" sind, die mit dieser Modeerscheinung die Welt übernehmen wollen.

Gary zieht mit seiner mormonischen Familie nach South Park und besucht die Schule. Seine Freundlichkeit kommt bei den Freunden schlecht an, doch Stan ist mehr und mehr von der Familie begeistert, sodass auch sein Vater Randy Mormone werden will.

Die Gruppe Butt Out von der Anti-Raucher-Kampagne kommt nach South Park, um vor den Kindern eine Anti-Raucher-Show abzuziehen. Neben peinlichen Freestyle-Raps, blödem Beatboxing und uncoolen Tänzen haben die 4 Leute jedoch nicht viel zu vermitteln.

Stan ist schon sein ganzes Leben mit Wendy zusammen. Als sie ihm über Bebe ausrichten lässt, dass sie ihn verlässt, bricht für ihn eine Welt zusammen. Während er versucht, wieder mit ihr zusammenzukommen, tröstet sie sich schon mit einem anderen.

Jimmy macht bei den Paralympics mit, findet aber nicht zu seiner alten Form. Er besorgt sich Steroide und wird schnell süchtig nach Muskeln. Timmy versucht ihn zur Vernunft zu bringen, aber vergeblich. Am Ende sieht er seinen Fehler selbst ein.

Kenny, Stan, Kyle und Cartman setzen sich maximal für ihre neue Nachrichtensendung in der Schule ein. Die Konkurrenz ist aber sehr stark und sie können es mit Craigs Show nicht aufnehmen. Dann droht auch noch der Sender zu schließen.

Ein radikaler Dokumentarfilmer platziert eine lebende Kuh vor "Bob's Burgers", um ein Statement über Fast-Food und Fleischkonsum zu machen. Bob ist außer sich vor Wut, als die Anwesenheit des Rinds beginnt, seine Kunden zu vergraulen. Zur Überraschung aller ändert Bob bald seine Meinung und behandelt das Tier wie ein vollwertiges Familienmitglied.

Linda entdeckt, dass es Restaurants gibt, die sogenannte Krimidinner veranstalten. Das bedeutet, dass sowohl Essen serviert als auch begleitend eine Kriminalgeschichte von Laiendarstellern dargeboten wird. Nun möchte sie auch "Bobs Burgers" zumindest einmalig in ein solches Restaurant umwandeln. Widerwillig stimmt Bob zu. In der Premierennacht ändern einige unerwartete Unterbrechungen - unter anderem ein echter Überfall auf das Restaurant - den Verlauf des eigentlich geplanten Stücks.

Tina ist verzweifelt: Sie möchte zur Feier ihres 13. Geburtstages unbedingt ihren ersten Kuss mit einem Jungen zelebrieren. Dafür will sie ein Restaurant mieten und zu einer Party-Location mit Diskokugel und DJ umwandeln. Jimmy Pesto, der Besitzer, ist davon jedoch nicht begeistert und verbietet seinem Sohn, zu der Party zu gehen. Als Tina das erfährt, bricht für sie eine Welt zusammen. Bob versucht, seiner Tochter zu helfen.

Es steht ein langes Wochenende an. Linda beschließt, ein paar Zimmer ihrer Wohnung an Gäste zu vermieten. Dazu müssen Bob und die nicht begeisterten Kinder einige Zimmer hergeben. Doch es kommen nur seltsame Gäste, die man besser im Auge behält.

Stan will, dass die Kinder mehr draußen spielen, allerdings verbietet Francine einen Ausflug. Also betäubt Stan die Kinder und nimmt sie mit auf das CIA-Holodeck. Hayley kauft außerdem Rogers Heimatstern, um seine Königin zu werden.

Aus Versehen hat Malcolm seiner Nachbarin, der sonderbaren und furchterregenden alten Hexe Mrs. Griffin, den Arm gebrochen.

Eine neue Mitschülerin zeigt Interesse an Malcolm, und auch er fühlt die Schmetterlinge im Bauch. Für Dewey ist es ein Schock, als Lois ihm seinen Teddy wegnimmt, weil sie das Kuscheltier zu unhygienisch findet.

Stan glaubt, dass Hayley alleine nicht lebensfähig wäre und lässt sie in Rogers Kneipe arbeiten, um praktische Erfahrungen für das Leben zu sammeln. Bei ihrem Job freundet sie sich mit Bullock an. Stan will diese Freundschaft für sich nutzen.
Stans Kollegen beim CIA bringen ihm die sogenannte "Rubbernecking"-Technik bei, mit welcher man in Gesellschaft der Ehefrau unbemerkt auch anderen interessanten Damen hinterherschauen kann.

Stan verliert seinen Job und muss sich etwas Neues suchen. Allerdings darf er seine 20 Jahre Berufserfahrung beim CIA nicht in seinen Lebenslauf schreiben und bekommt deshalb nur einen Job in einem Lebensmittelladen. Sein neuer Boss ist Steve.

A guilt-ridden Joey finally confesses his love for Rachel to the flabbergasted Ross, while Chandler becomes nervous when Phoebe's handsome new boyfriend Don shares numerous personality traits with Monica.
In an effort to restore normality to their friendship, Rachel tells Joey a big lie about her unborn child. Meanwhile, Phoebe's tea leaves reveal that she will soon encounter the man of her dreams.

Phoebe brings her irritatingly cheerful boyfriend to Mr and Mrs Geller's 35th anniversary party. Meanwhile, Ross is stunned when his parents ask him and the pregnant Rachel to feign marriage to avoid scandal.
South Park's politically incorrect past catches up with it when the new principal at South Park Elementary lays down the law and Cartman bears the brunt of his wrath.
Mr Garrison is crazy-mad about all the illegal immigrants in South Park, so it's time for a showdown with the familiar looking President of Canada! Cartman has other plans.
Gentrification hits South Park and Kenny's family take the brunt of it! Mr Kim's City Wok, also suffering, hires Kenny as part of their 'child labour force'!
There's a new craze in town, being a freeloading, online food critic! Kyle's dad and Cartman are leading the way! But just how much will the restaurants stand for?
When Cartman starts getting fat shamed on the internet, P.C. Principle steps in to save the day with the help of Steven Seagal! Meanwhile, Randy is enduring some charity shaming.
When Craig and Tweek are outed as gay, they're as surprised as everyone else. Sounds like it's time for Cartman's cupid self to work his magic, and maybe on Cartman too.
Jimmy, GK Barry and Jamali are passing judgement on some potential wrongdoers. Taking the stand tonight is a romantic gesture fail, and someone who refuses to date if the stars don't align.
Robert and Amy exchange vows in a wedding ceremony that has the Barone family tradition written all over it.
Debra convinces Ray to let her join him on the golf course after she once again realises that they don't have fun together any more.
Robert is caught in a compromising position by Amy's parents when they turn up unannounced at her flat.
When Robert is put in charge of selecting his wedding invitations, Ray suggests he intentionally botch the assignment so that Amy will let him off the hook with their wedding plans.
Ex-footballer Charlie Burrows leaves London with his daughter to start a new life in the country, keeping house for a female executive with a son.
Caroline is impressed with Charlie's work around the house, but he finds more than he bargained for in her bathroom.
Charlie is expecting someone for dinner - but so is Caroline.
Caroline's university reunion brings a visit from her old rival - who helps herself to whatever she fancies.
Caroline disapproves of Charlie's attitude towards the children's fighting, but a traumatic day forces her to eat her words.
Caroline and Charlie lie to new acquaintances.
Host Aisha Tyler joins comic regulars along with special guests comic Gary Anthony Williams and actor Yvette Nicole Brown as they perform improvised sketches prompted by ideas from the audience.
Host Aisha Tyler joins comic regulars along with special guests comic Jeff Davis and actor Gina Rodriguez as they perform improvised sketches prompted by ideas from the audience.
Criminally funny clips including bad drivers, vigilante OAPs, and a mugging by a marsupial!
Illegal idiocy including a law-breaking bride and a thief holding up a shop using a banana!
Featuring motoring misdemeanours, citizens arrests and delinquent animals.
Criminal capers including bad getaways, raccoons in a freezer, and OAPs out for justice.
Deplorable deeds featuring delinquent duos, drunk drivers, and daring escapes.
A smorgasbord of crime featuring action-packed getaways and some adolescent law-breakers.
Today's caseload includes felonious farmers, daring escapes, and package pilfering.
A cacophony of crime featuring sinful Santas, bad bears, and a jailbird on a jet ski.
Featuring public enemies, a tribe facing arrest, and OAPs with attitude.
Crime capers including Christmas criminals, package plundering, and motoring mayhem!

Joey is thrilled when his name is used in a 'Soap Opera Digest' crossword puzzle. He is reluctant to let the magazine do a profile of him, but Rachel tries to persuade him to reconsider so that he can mention her.

Monica and Phoebe host Rachel's baby shower but forget to invite her mother. Rachel realises she is clueless about caring for the baby after birth. Meanwhile, Joey auditions to host a new game show called 'Bamboozled'.

When Monica's cooking at the restaurant receives a harsh write-up in a newspaper, she goes to a criticism class taught by the reviewer, hoping to convince him to reconsider his opinion. Meanwhile, Rachel gets upset when a cute salesgirl flirts with Ross while he and Rachel are shopping for baby supplies, and nervous about a major job interview, Chandler receives some questionable coaching from Phoebe.
Eight days overdue, Rachel grows irritable, prompting a bet between Monica and Phoebe. Meanwhile, Joey invites Chandler to his new film's screening.
Rachel waits in the hospital maternity ward with an anxious Ross. To her dismay, she is put in a semi-private room. Then, the heavily pregnant Janice is assigned to share the room with her.
Rachel doubts Ross's commitment to her and the baby. Meanwhile, Ross wants to confess his love for Rachel. Joey discovers Ross's mother's engagement ring on the floor.

Host Jimmy Carr and team captains Sean Lock and Jon Richardson are joined by Jack Dee, Claudia Winkleman, David O'Doherty and Josh Widdicombe as they thrash out the hot topics of the week by examining surveys, opinion polls and statistics.
Host Jimmy Carr and team captains Sean Lock and Jon Richardson are joined by Richard Bacon, Gemma Collins, Katherine Ryan and Henning Wehn as they thrash out the hot topics of the week.
Aisha Tyler hosts another memorable episode of the legendary improv show featuring regulars Wayne Brady, Ryan Stiles and Colin Mochrie along with guest performer Gary Anthony Williams.
Stand-up comedian Fern Brady brings her unique take on contemporary culture and the state of the UK to a packed crowd in Glasgow.
Beavis receives the worst news of his life. Middle-aged Beavis and Butt-Head pay a visit to their old friend Stewart.
Sara Pascoe, Alan Davies, Darren Harriott and sidekick John Kearns welcome Glenn Moore, Amy Gledhill, Ria Lina and Scarlett Moffatt to play another round of absurd guessing games.
Sal, Q and Murr are crashing and burning into product displays and hiding in tight spaces, but one of them must face the music with celebrity guest Bret Michaels.
The jokers give unsolicited etiquette advice and live tape strange product reviews; one lucky joker takes all the blame for celebrity guest Post Malone.

As Joey agonises over his secret affection for Rachel, Monica mistakenly thinks that he is infatuated with Phoebe. Meanwhile, Ross and Rachel promise not to try to find out the sex of their unborn child, but Rachel can't resist having a peek inside the doctor's confidential folder. Also, Monica urges a reluctant Chandler to enjoy the soothing pleasures of a scented bath, but realises that she's created a tub monster.

Joey rushes pregnant Rachel to hospital when she experiences pains. When Ross feels left out, Joey makes a gallant suggestion. Meanwhile, Chandler is surprised to discover what is behind the locked door of Monica's secret cupboard, and Phoebe gets the impression that Monica is enjoying one of her massages a little too much.

Due to a misunderstanding, Rachel finds herself engaged to Joey instead of Ross shortly after giving birth to her and Ross's baby girl. Meanwhile, Joey can't help taking a look as Rachel tries unsuccessfully to nurse her baby. Inspired to have a baby of their own, Monica and Chandler retire to a hospital cupboard for a little privacy.

Joey's futile attempts to gain Ross's forgiveness for mistakenly asking Rachel to marry him only result in emergency hospitalisation. Meanwhile, an exhausted Rachel desperately searches for a solution to end baby Emma's non-stop crying.

Rachel's constant calls to Emma's paediatrician force him to reject her as a patient. Meanwhile, Chandler plans to move to Tulsa for work, but worries about whether career-minded Monica is still willing to join him, and Joey and Phoebe agree to find each other companions for a double date.

Phoebe fears losing her latest prospective boyfriend Mike and her self-doubt is not helped by Ross' careless comments. Meanwhile, Chandler is in Tulsa on a work assignment, and when Monica surprises him in his hotel room, she mistakenly thinks that he has a sexual fetish for sharks.

While Phoebe and Joey wait at a fancy restaurant for their friends' arrival to celebrate Phoebe's birthday, Rachel is delayed because she is afraid to leave Emma with a babysitter. Monica and Chandler also fail to arrive on time after having a row about Chandler's urge to resume smoking and then giving in to other urges.
Ross mocks Rachel's new male nanny, and Chandler becomes upset when Monica says that somebody from her job is the funniest guy she's ever met.

When Chandler's former romantic rival intends to sell his flat, insecure Chandler persuades Joey to help him secretly inspect it and the guys are shocked to discover an old videotape featuring Monica having sex with Richard.

On the night before Thanksgiving, Rachel's self-centred younger sister Amy ruins everyone's holiday dinner with her uncensored observations. Meanwhile, Monica obsessively protects her good wedding china, and Joey forgets to join his television cast mates in the big Thanksgiving parade.

Rachel impulsively gives a handsome restaurant patron her telephone number, and worries that he'll call when Ross is in their apartment. Meanwhile, Phoebe's boyfriend Mike and Ross desperately try to find something in common to talk about when they babysit Emma, and Chandler returns from Tulsa to visit Monica, but must hide from Joey after rejecting his offer of free basketball tickets.

Chandler is forced to remain in Tulsa over the Christmas period due to a major deadline at work, and Monica fears the worst when she finds out that he will be joined in Tulsa by a beautiful colleague Wendy. While he works, Chandler recalls some of the more embarrassing moments from previous holidays shared with his friends.
Mr Bean goes Christmas shopping, conducts a Salvation Army band, and has Christmas dinner with his long-suffering girlfriend.
Mr Bean treats himself to a weekend at a posh hotel where he manages to get himself into one embarrassing situation after another.

A tough cop is forced to go undercover as a kindergarten teacher. In his new role, he must track down a mother and son who are the only witnesses against a drug-dealing criminal, who is also their husband and father. The cop uses his brutal methods to negotiate the mundane problems of child control.
Britain's best-known pub philosopher serves up his own special brew of comic bar-room banter in his 2010 show.

Detective Riggs and Murtaugh are called into action to foil a Chinese crime lord who is selling immigrants into slavery on American soil. The pair aren't as young as they used to be, and ending up on a Triad hit list doesn't make things easy for them either.
Live gavel-to-gavel coverage, in-depth legal reporting and expert analysis of America's most important and compelling trials.

When a predator plans to meet a 13-year-old at the mall, Detective Tony Godwin races to pull off his fastest ever takedown. Then, an FBI lead points to one home and two suspects. And a predator's deviant secret is discovered in a church dumpster.

Law enforcement officers pursue fugitives on the run. Deputies get in a high-speed chase with a man wanted for shooting a motorway patrolman and stealing his cruiser; officers pursue a fugitive who's driving recklessly.

Law enforcement officers pursue fugitives on the run. Deputies race to extract a mother and her daughters from their truck after a fleeing suspect crashes into them. And fish and wildlife officers pursue a fugitive attempting to escape by swimming.

A look at some of the country's strangest arrests: an off-duty pilot allegedly tries to shut down a plane's engine at 30,000 feet, a delivery driver is arrested for contaminating sandwiches, and an e-bike rider demands a lawyer.

A look at some of the strangest arrests from across the country: a golf cart cruises onto a moving walkway at the airport, a fraternity hazing leaves pledges half-naked in a basement, and a 70-year-old man drives his Cybertruck into a lake.
As his date with the executioner draws near, Ted Bundy offers to confess to eight Washington State murders.

Ted Bundy is finally executed in 1989; six years later Gary Ridgway is caught and charged with 40 Green River murders; when Ridgway confesses, Detective Robert Keppel realises how accurate Bundy's taped predictions were.
A beloved University of Kentucky football player is murdered on his doorstep during his 21st birthday party in an assassination-style killing.
When homesick university student Miya Marcano books a flight to South Florida for the weekend, her family is thrilled. However, when the plane lands, Miya is nowhere to be found.
Weeks after a pregnant woman is shot and killed in Orlando, a shootout between her suspected killer and a police officer sparks a manhunt.

Two cold cases, the 1992 murder of school teacher Christy Mirack in Lancaster, Pennsylvania, and the 1990 murder of Genevieve Zitricki in Greenville, South Carolina, were finally solved thanks to advancements in DNA technology.

Jennifer Pan was found guilty of staging a home invasion with the intention of killing her own parents. When her father awoke after surviving a gunshot wound, he was able to unpick the details of his daughter's sadistic plot.
A closer look at the case of Darren Byrne, a former city trader who killed his wife and then tried to burn down the family home after she discovered that he was having an affair.
Dermot Murnaghan explores the case of Lewis Daynes, who, at the age of 18, was sentenced to life in prison for the fatal stabbing of 14-year-old Breck Bednar.
...Murnaghan. New. The story of Ben Geen, who was convicted of murdering two patients in his care at Horton General Hospital. He maintains his innocence to this day. (S4, ep 8)

The quiet seaside town of Mablethorpe was an unlikely location for what appeared to be an organised hit on a couple in their 50s. Emilia travels to the Lincolnshire coast to learn about the violent murders of Joan and John Stirland in 2004.
Emilia uncovers details surrounding the brutal murder of Rosie Darbyshire. Witnesses and CCTV were key to solving the case that shocked the local community.
In April 2019, the remains of a woman were found in a freezer in a flat in London's East End. Investigators brought the freezer to be x-rayed, and it revealed two frozen bodies.
Laurent Bonomo and Gabriel Ferez are awoken in the middle of the night and tied up after Sonnex and Farmer climbed through an open window of their flat in New Cross, south London.

Shakira Spencer's death was the culmination of systematic cruelty by people she originally thought were friends. Shakira was isolated, tortured and abused at a time when people were rarely allowed to visit each other.
Kasim Lewis admits to killing Catherine Burke, 55, in a sexually inspired murder, while serving life for the murder of 22-year-old Iuliana Tudos.
Angela Cannings faces every parent's worst nightmare when she discovers her 18-week-old son, Matthew, unresponsive in his cot. By the time the ambulance crew arrive, he's already dead.
Following a violent attack that leaves a woman dead, police launch an urgent investigation. Detectives believe it's a robbery gone wrong and fix their sights on local burglar: Justin Plummer.

Suspected of a crime he knows nothing about, Andrew Malkinson agrees to help the police clear up the confusion. Convicted in 2004, Andrew never stopped protesting his innocence. Explore the case that continues to spark debate.
A look at some of the strangest arrests from across the country. A naked man allegedly attacks police with a shovel, and a woman refuses to leave a restaurant until she gets a free glass of water.

A look at some of the strangest arrests from across the country: a naked woman attempts to elude police by jumping into the ocean; a man attacks a police car with a chainsaw; a woman claims her dad is Jesus Christ; and more!
An off-duty police officer shoots a man in the chest after a social event explodes into a deadly argument between the two men. The Defence believes this is a clear case of self-defence.

When beloved mother Janora Stevens is found brutally stabbed in her Tulsa, Oklahoma, home, her family is bitterly divided and increasingly suspicious of each other. The case chills until a trail of tell-tale fibres leads cops to her killer.
Focusing on a different location each week in the modern State of Israel and showing its relevance as a tourist site while highlighting its significance in the Bible.
'Healing Miracles' showcases the healing power of Jesus Christ with Addison Adamu by exploring various healing testimonies and miracles from people of all walks of life.

The Christian Worship Hour with Dr Harold E. Salem proclaims the Word of God simply and humbly in all its truth and purity, with special concern and compassion for the lost and with hope and encouragement for all believers.
Tim Timberlake brings a message of hope and inspiration that will build faith and trust in God. He goes directly to God's Word to provide solutions to some of life's toughest problems.
The worldwide ministry of Rod Parsley and his work to revive the life of God in human hearts.
Join Pastors Larry and Tiz Huch from Dallas, Texas as they share revelations from the Word of God.
Messianic rabbi KA Schneider looks at how the Old and New Testaments are integrated, building faith and changing lives.
A longtime foster child attends a church-based support group whose leader uses the Ten Commandments as the basis of his teachings.
Renowned Christian scholar Rick Renner delves into the Greek New Testament, blending historical texts with modern illustrations to unpack God's message for His believers.

Featuring in-depth interviews, as host Gary Stearman talks with expert writers, teachers and pastors. Discussions range across the spectrum of Bible prophecy as seen through both history and current events.
Dr Charles Stanley, pastor of the First Baptist Church in Atlanta, shares his insights on Christian faith and enlightens viewers with spiritual motivation.
Minister Rick Pearson discusses the hidden mysteries of America's role in Bible prophecy.
Perry Stone delivers a practical message in order to reach the lost, to teach the Word, and to show the anointing of the Holy Spirit through evangelism and worship.
Familiar hymns and beautifully produced original music accompany Scripture to help you let go and surrender during a time of daily prayer and meditation.
Rabbi Jonathan Bernis of Jewish Voice Ministries shares the lessons he learned after his miraculous health recovery.
Equipping Pastors, group leaders and church members with biblical truth and tools to heal themselves and take healing to a wounded world.
Pastor Ron Carpenter of Redemption Bay Area in San Jose, California presents Bible-based teachings, teaching truth and knowledge through a kingdom perspective.
An impactful prophetic program that will edify and propel you forward, and upwards in your spiritual life.

Chris Mitchell reports from one of the most explosive regions in the world. Offers a biblical and prophetic perspective to the daily news events that shape our world, with a particular focus on Israel and the Middle East.
Israel Now News is a weekly TV news magazine. It presents a unique perspective of Israel's current events, politics, and culture to an English-speaking audience.

Dr. Creflo Dollar ministers to all walks of life with hope for change. With a renewal of faith, mind, and spirit, he and his wife Taffi share their vision for all to understand God's love and promises.
The teaching ministry of American Southern Baptist pastor and television host Dr Robert Jeffress. He is a Senior Minister of the First Baptist Church in Dallas as well as a Fox News contributor.
Free Chapel pastor, Jentezen Franklin, shares his interpretation of the Bible by bringing practical meaning to spiritual truths in a contemporary world.
Pastors John and Matt Hagee of Hagee Ministries in San Antonio, TX, deliver messages from God's Word, proclaiming the bold truth of His promises.
Pastor Allen Jackson brings a Biblical perspective to the ever-changing world, encouraging believers to lead with their faith in every arena - no matter what shaking the season may bring.
Messages from author and evangelist Joel Osteen as he preaches of love and hope. The pastor urges people to live to their full potential and form a close relationship with God.

Dr Michael Youssef speaks about the Word of God or the Gospel in order to help people who have lost faith in God and assist them to tread the path of righteousness by following the teachings of Jesus.
Pastor Travis Johnson, travels around the world and builds a strong network while ministering through different churches.
A biblical and prophetic exploration of Israel, past, present and future. Hosted by Dr. John Tweedie and filmed entirely on location in Israel.
A spiritual ministry dealing with such issues as health, family values and spiritual principles.
A church service including praise and worship and an inspiring message by Pastor Mac Hammond.

When an alligator turns on its owner, he tries to sell it to the Golds but Ashley and Seth want no part of the reptile. A man wants to pawn his bulletproof vest, so Les tells him he needs to take him outside and test it.

Tensions boil over when a customer flips out over a mix-up with his gold chain. Then, Ashley loses it when a customer tries to pawn a cursed relic and hopes that its deadly history won't catch up with her.

An employee becomes violent and nearly tears the family apart. Ashley goes through the roof when an aggressive customer tries to sell 50 pairs of some-not-so-clean panties and a wacky puppet-maker turns out replicas of the staff.
Les and Seth clash over the business when Les' idea to give away massive cash in the car park creates a dangerous situation. Also, Ashley embarks on a new in-house business venture.

Seth and Ashley argue over buying a collection of venomous reptiles and hissing roaches, making the staff uncomfortable. Meanwhile, the Golds are unhappy with their security team's performance and decide to look for a new head of security.

While exploring the historic silver mining town of Cobalt, the salvage team uncovers some exciting hidden treasures inside an old Nash car dealership, including a massive 1915 Woolworth's sign and vintage jukeboxes.
Under the watchful eye of Uncle Ryan, Julien puts his operator skills to the test during a delicate and risky demolition job.
Vic goes on a road trip to salvage a pair of vintage gas pumps to add to his personal collection.
As the Priestlys look to the future, Ted's salvage team is tasked with clearing out The National with a huge one-day sale.
Competition boils over when bitter rivals Brandon and Jesse throw down over a storage unit containing an amazing movie monster and a potential hundred thousand dollar payout.
Brandon and Lori Bernier find a potentially priceless piece of rock and roll history when they unearth a record producer's storage unit.
A score of a lifetime hidden beneath hunting and sporting equipment, a do-or-die bidding war over a locker full of liquor and rare Mardi Gras masks.
Former boxer Brandon Bernier and his wife Lori attempt to win the often jaw-dropping contents of abandoned storage units at auction. Highlights include voodoo dolls and taxidermy.
All bets are off as the auction-goers battle for bargains in Las Vegas. Dustin continues to pose a threat to Brandon and Lori as mystery bins test their resolve.
Emotions run high when Brandon, Lori and Jesse battle over the same units throughout the entire auction. Will the bidders hit the jackpot in Vegas?
Brandon and Lori square off against Wade, and the contents of a unit create outrage among the buyers.
The contents of what looks like an old retail store show its true identity, and a whale tusk could mean a windfall.
Fly-on-the-wall series featuring a couple who bid for potentially lucrative items left in storage. Brandon and Jesse are forced to join forces.
More drama in the auction rooms and beyond as Brandon and Lori enter an all out bidding war. In California, they're about to find out if vomit can really be valuable.
Dramatic auction action. Are Brandon and Lori feeling the thrill of taxidermy when a dead cow pitches up in one of their storage unit lots?
Fortunes are made and lost at auctions in this dramatic series. In Culver City, Brandon should change his name to Bond after winning loads of spy equipment.
Mechanics Will and Gus go in search of iconic British sports cars for under £1000. They find a classic MG F to refurbish, but the car has many minor problems.
The team knows that the BMW Mini is a solid and popular car. They decide to buy one for six hundred pounds on eBay. But cheap turns out to be expensive when problems come to light.
The guys are looking for a French car that is not a 2CV as they are expensive and rusty. But once they come across this one, it's impossible to turn it down.
This once £35,000 car has been given up on. The previous owner can't get the roof to work or the car to run, so they are selling it.
Since the Ford is a highly desired model, the team set its sights on an Orion. The car is definitely economical, but the steering wheel is on the wrong side.
The team find a Rolls-Royce that lures them to Yorkshire. Although it is old, the car is very economical, and the high quality can still be felt.

Gus and Will are after a classic BMW, but Gus insists on a classic Audi that has caught his eye and forces it on Will. But it's the start of a joint love affair as the Audi's great engine and style wins them over.
The guys buy a legendary golf and instantly fall for it. At first everything seems to be fine with the car, but the truth is revealed when they remove the trim strips around the wheel well.

The classic Fiat 500 is too expensive, so the team decide to look for a Fiat 126. Will and Gus hunt for neglected cars that they can fix and flip for a profit, but any losses will come out of their own pockets.
The Toyota Sera is a concept car with gull-wing doors and a 50s-style space age glass roof. It's also extremely rare, and the guys find one that's drivable, but not in the way they need.
The team acquire a Triumph Herald that has only had two owners. If the engine, brakes, and gear can be repaired, it will be a gem.
The four-wheel-drive Freelander was once Europe's most popular car. It looks good and runs well, but it failed the inspection on so many points that its owner gave up.

Following Bruce Crompton as he travels the globe to buy and sell wartime memorabilia.

How do they make the tank piercing super bullet? Plus, how do they forge the infamous torture weapon, the dentist's drill?

Legendary places of protection, from a historic military fortress in Gibraltar and Pablo Escobar's secret Colombian hideaway to a floating kingdom on Peru's Lake Titicaca.

Bluey und seine Freunde spielen auf der Wiese. Sie dürfen nur die Schattenstellen berühren.

Dad lässt sich in dieser Episode in ein Hotel-Spiel verwickeln. Bluey und Bingo leiten das Hotel. Dad nimmt die Rolle des umsorgten Gastes ein. Bluey neigt dazu, das Spiel an sich zu reißen. Aus diesem Grund will Bingo nicht mehr spielen.

Diese Sendung wirbt für verschiedene Produkte, die man sich bequem nach Hause schicken lassen kann.

Josh sucht nach einem streng geheimen Wasserflugzeug aus dem Zweiten Weltkrieg, das im Pazifik abstürzt ist. 70 Jahre später schließt er sich einem Team an, das den Meeresboden in Hunderten Metern Tiefe durchsucht, um den verlorenen Schatz zu finden.

Die Ameisen schmecken widerlich, aber Jermaine darf bei der Nahrungsauswahl nicht wählerisch sein, denn sein Körper benötigt Proteine. Und auch kleine Mengen können am Ende den Unterschied ausmachen. Was baut unterdessen eine Flusskrebs-Falle.

Ein Grizzlybär hat in den Rocky Mountains einen Mann angefallen und das Opfer hat die Attacke nicht überlebt. Das sind beunruhigende Nachrichten für die Outdoor-Cracks, denn beim nächsten Mal könnte es einen von ihnen treffen.
Wer bringt sein Wasser schneller zum Kochen? Die Bushcraft-Profis aus Australien und den Südstaaten der USA treten in Südafrika bei einem Ausscheidungswettkampf gegeneinander an.

Amazonas-Bezwinger Ed Stafford geht in der Wildnis bis an seine Grenzen. In dieser Doku-Serie versucht der Survival-Spezialist zehn Tage lang an den gefährlichsten Orten der Welt zu überleben - ohne Kompass, Ausrüstung und Proviant. Auf seinen gefährlichen Trips ins Okavangodelta, in den Regenwald Borneos und die Tafelberge in Venezuela bewegt sich der Brite auf gefährlichem Terrain.

In dieser Folge bekommen es Luke Purdy und seine Crew auf Stradbroke Island mit einem acht Tonnen schweren Boot zu tun. Die 12 Meter lange Jacht ist in einem geschützten Mangroven-Gebiet, das der indigenen Bevölkerung gehört, auf Grund gelaufen.

Brett und Sahra sind verzweifelt. Der einzige Zugang zu ihrer Farm wurde bei einem Hochwasser fortgespült. Und wenn ihre Macadamianuss-Ernte nicht innerhalb der 24 Stunden zur Weiterverarbeitung abtransportiert wird, verlieren sie rund 15 000 Dollar.

Tropenstürme haben in der nördlichen Region zwei versunkene Autowracks freigelegt. Die Vehikel stellen eine Bedrohung für die Umwelt dar, denn in dem Reservat legen bedrohte Meeresschildkröten ihre Eier ab und müssen deswegen geborgen werden.

Claes und seine Kollegin befragen in Stockholm eine ältere Frau. Die Dame macht einen verwirrten Eindruck. Sie hält sich schon seit drei Tagen am Flughafen auf und will in die USA reisen, um dort eine Online-Bekanntschaft zu treffen.
Claes versucht, am Stockholmer Flughafen eine angespannte Situation zu entschärfen. Ein Reisender verhält sich aggressiv und weigert sich, mit den Sicherheitskräften zu sprechen.

Enorm hohe Betriebskosten: Parker Schnabel gibt pro Woche fast eine Million Dollar aus. Gleichzeitig sinkt die Goldausbeute. Seine Hauptsorge gilt der „Goldenen Meile". Rick Ness und seine Crew bewegen unterdessen gigantische Mengen an Erdreich.
Tony Beets bekommt Besuch. Sein jüngerer Bruder Klaas ist zu Gast in Nordamerika. Die beiden Männer sind zusammen auf einer Milchfarm in den Niederlanden aufgewachsen.

Ein Freund hat die Machereys damit beauftragt, herauszufinden, ob sich im Northern Territory Australiens Gold finden lässt. Doch die extreme Hitze und die mangelnde Infrastruktur sorgen bei dieser Aufgabe für einige Probleme.

Nachdem Andreas Macherey Goldnuggets gefunden hat, geraten er und sein Sohn Tobi in einen Goldrausch. Um mehr Nuggets zu finden, wollen sie die Umgebung mit einer Drohne kartieren. Doch dabei müssen sie auf Wasserbüffel aufpassen.

Das Grauen ist noch immer allgegenwärtig: Die Häftlinge auf der ehemaligen Gefängnisinsel Spike Island mussten schreckliche Dinge erleiden, obwohl einige von ihnen während der Hungersnot lediglich ein Brot gestohlen hatten.
Ignacia suffers from a facial tumour that could asphyxiate her. Thomas has a rare bone eating disease that has destroyed the left side of his torso.

The two siblings grew up working at their father's successful restaurant nearby, but when they opened their own establishment, the customers didn't materialise. A flu epidemic decimates the ranks of a local police force. With no other options, the powers-that-be bring in raw green recruits to tackle crime.
D'Artagnan and his comrades come to the aid of king and country when the evil Richelieu plots an alliance with Britain.

A widowed farmer, with a brave but brutal military past, decides not to join up when the British arrive in 1776. However, when his son enlists and is later captured by the enemy, the former soldier must abandon his new-found pacifist principles in order to rescue his oldest child, and forms a regiment of Carolina patriots, whose guerrilla tactics prove pivotal to the US war effort.
A man carries out his own agenda for justice after a judge encourages him to round up the men who tried to lynch him.
In 1887, three violent fugitives hold a couple and their children hostage in their isolated New Mexico farmhouse.
Taking the viewer back in time with a look at news headlines from this week, back then.
After a long-lost antique sword reappears, Mannering finds himself in direct competition with a rival antiques dealer.
A stolen gold medallion is discovered on a dead airline steward, which links him to one of the biggest art smuggling rings in the world.
After tracking down a thief who stole his Fabergé bauble, Mannering agrees to help British intelligence take down a ring of art thieves hiding behind diplomatic immunity.
Another trip to Kodiak, Alaska, for the intrepid exploits of the US Coast Guard. The crew respond to a call from a tiny fishing boat, 26 miles from the coast.
The women and men of Air Station Sitka take on three dangerous missions which include an intense medevac for a heart attack victim near death.
In 1864 wealthy banker Thomas Briggs was the first murder victim on a British railway.
Hitler spends much of his time during World War II at the Berghof, his residence in the mountains of southeast Germany.
Hitler's most trusted minister arrives with a lethal canister.

A band of Confederate soldiers capture a large consignment of Yankee gold, then go on the run with their haul when they realise that the war has ended. Although no longer threatened by the Yankees, they soon find themselves under attack from ruthless bandits determined to get their hands on the gold.
An ex-Missouri raider is hired to lead pioneers through Oregon in 1847 to establish a farming community, only to be betrayed by his best friend.
A young cavalry lieutenant's friendship with the local Navajo chief comes under strain with the arrival of an aggressive new commanding officer and a group of warmongering Confederate sympathisers.

Monte Walsh is a cowboy in the 1890s Wyoming, who finds calls for his expertise waning, as civilisation advances west. Should he head out for the last remaining wide open spaces, or stay with his sweetheart and take a job with the travelling Wild West show run by Colonel Wilson?

A flying saucer piloted by alien Klaatu lands in Washington to warn Earth to change its warring ways or risk destruction. Along the way Klaatu finds time to learn more about Earth in the company of Helen Benson and her son.

A woman claims to be tormented by apparitions. The story of a teen being attacked by a demonic beast. Rocky Primiani shares his story of encounters with the afterlife.
Chris Houston is haunted by an evil ghost boy. A farmhouse is cursed by the presence of dark entities. Something dangerously demonic lurks in Bonnie Shukofsky's home.
The story of a woman who is followed by the evil spirit of a bootlegger. Felicia Sills finds a Civil War-era ring.
Ron's dead mother comes back from the grave to visit him in his home, while the ghost of Pam's mum surprises her grieving daughter, in an episode about just how deep a mother's love goes.

In Ontario cottage country, an investigator is stalked by a terrifying beast-like entity; in Ohio, Karlo and his team are frozen in fear when they come face to face with the ghost of an executioner on an old jail's death row.
Michelle Desrochers' dream trip to Transylvania turns into a nightmare, while in New York, paranormal investigators are attacked by a dangerous entity stalking an old church.
The spirit of a murderer tries to possess an investigator in an Ohio library, and a woman is terrorised by shadow-like figures in her home in Massachusetts.
A woman and her teenage daughter are terrorised by apparitions, while in Arizona, something sinister is found lurking in an abandoned factory.
A member of the team suffers a potentially fatal paranormal attack in a prison in Ohio, and a mother and son in Phoenix are tormented by a spirit.

Summoning the 18th-century buccaneers who ran a South Carolina port in the golden age of piracy, uncovering the truth about a ghost ship and a creepy bedroom in the city's oldest tavern, and confronting a spirit stalking one of the investigators.

The team investigates paranormal activity linked to an overwhelming number of natural disasters, contacts spirits in a hotel built atop a hospital, explores an eerie bed and breakfast, and finds troubled souls in America's most haunted city.

Sailing to Bell Island, Newfoundland, where the investigators reach out to the ghosts left by a devastating Nazi U-boat attack during WW II, and descending into darkness as the trio reveals a group of ghostly miners trapped underground for 80 years.
Paranormal investigators tap into the history of one of Ireland's ghostliest spots as they find out who, or what, is lurking in the shadows of this terrifying fortress.
A man shares his story of a monster attack. The story of a couple who experienced violent paranormal activity. Holly shares her story of being haunted be her ex-husband's ghost.

The team explores Harlan County's courthouse and jail, seeking evidence of apparitions, eerie voices and other unexplained phenomena. This grim execution site may still harbour echoes of a revenge killing and the region's coal wars.

The team conducts a thorough investigation at White Hall manor, seeking the alleged screaming ghost of legislator Cassius Marcellus Clay. They delve into the life of this uncompromising political figure who is said to haunt the halls.
The team investigates the history of an Old Louisville house where almost every member of the mysterious Brennan family died.

New equipment helps investigators contact familiar spirits at the Conrad-Caldwell House Museum. Fresh data and insights into the Kentucky Anomaly may aid Brandon in uncovering the core of this haunting.

Return to Jailer's Inn, where the team's first investigation finds a moving ball of environmental changes that registered on multiple metres. See if they can replicate their results as they investigate reports of voices and footsteps from upstairs.

The hunt is on for the ghost brother of Diamond Point's building director, who still feels his presence in the city welcome centre. Investigators explore apparitions, voices, and phantom smells that keep popping up in the former family home.
Probe the eerie Civil War apparitions inside a Confederate general's home.

Struggling with the loss of her childhood best friend and reluctant to discuss her pain, Carrie finds solace during a solitary horse ride. There, a paranormal event shifts her perspective on the possibility of life after death.
A tall, shadowy figure violently attacks a ten-year-old boy in his new home.
During a snow storm, a hospital worker stays the night alone and is startled when he sees the ghosts of staff and patients from World War I.
When Amy and her mother move into a deceased friend's home, they sense they are not alone.
The spirit of a family's dead cat fights against a mysterious canine presence.

Germany is in decline. Once the world's most powerful country is now being devastated by WWII. Adolf Hitler has gone into hiding. The dreaded ruler is no longer openly supporting his people. He is slowly losing his mind.

Explore the complexities of the man who would become one of history's most infamous figures. From his obscure beginnings in Austria to his meteoric rise as Germany's Führer, dive deep into the forces that shaped Hitler's ideology and his leadership.

This documentary programme uses archival footage, interviews and dramatic reconstructions to tell the story of the rise of the Nazis through time as well as the continued rise of Neo-Nazis. `The Rise of the Nazi Party' reveals how the National Socialists exploited economic turmoil to get into power in Germany in 1933 before leading the nation into an era of genocide and military defeat. It profiles the people who helped the Nazis bring destruction to Europe, including Hitler, Himmler and Goebbels.
As punishment for the 1923 'Putsch', Hitler is banned from public speaking. Now he employs Joseph Goebbels to feed Hitler's political ideology to the masses.
Hitler seizes his chance in the wake of The Great Depression, turning the people on the incumbent Democratic Weimar Government and promising a brighter future.
A month after coming to power, Hitler addresses his people through the radio. He promises to make the economy his priority - and the task ahead is massive.
Hitler summons Germany's military leaders to a shock meeting at his headquarters. He lays out his plans for military expansion into neighbouring territories.
Investigate Hitler's biggest mistake, and explore how the German people begin to see through the facade of the Nazi propaganda machine.
Explore how Adolf Hitler and the Nazi Party groomed the German people into thinking the genocide of Jewish people was a morally correct decision.
Explore how with Nazi Germany on the back foot, Hitler's attempts to cling to power become ever more desperate, leading to ever more deplorable consequences.
Explore how the Allies final advance on Nazi Germany in January 1945 sounded the death knell for the Third Reich, a regime which continued with its lies to the very end.

In the darkest days of World War II in the Pacific, an elite British military team sought to facilitate espionage and sabotage behind enemy lines. This now famous group, the British Special Operations Executive or MI6, faced a critical obstacle.
Europe became a dangerous place to be associated with the Nazi regime as thousands of Nazi officers, party members and supporters of Hitler began to flee Germany.
The ongoing battles in Manchuria, China, Abyssinia, and Spain each serve as a terrible precedent in their own way.

As the war consumes economic, agricultural and industrial resources, the extent of the war is realised across Europe, Asia and the Pacific.

Explores how people and resources became absorbed in the war efforts by occupying forces during WWII.

Explores how civilians became defenders against targets of aerial warfare, and the strategic bombing campaigns utilised in an attempt to end the war.

The cloak of war played a role in the genocide of WWII, allowing unfathomable horrors against innocent women, children, and men. Even within Allied nations, individuals were seen as potential enemies and denied liberty.

Explores the aftermath of WWII in the wake of destruction and liberation, with tens of millions dead and millions more displaced.

Napoleon Bonaparte, born in 1769 in Corsica, came from minor nobility and claimed Roman heritage.
Exploring the history of Paris' iconic cathedral, from its initial construction in 1163 to now.

An account of one of the most influential queens of France: Catherine de' Medici. Considered an immigrant, common and plain, de' Medici marries into the 16th century French court as an orphaned teenager.
Newsreel footage from May and June 1940 that recounts the blitzkrieg campaign leading to the fall of France.

Dan explores behind the battlements of Dover Castle and descends into an underground lair. There, he discovers how a vast network of tunnels had been used to defend both the castle and the country for centuries.

Built by William the Conqueror, the Tower of London is one of Britain's most iconic landmarks. It has been a military fortress, a palace, a royal mint, a prison, a zoo and a place of execution, a silent witness to some of the most momentous events in our history. Dan Jones reveals some of its fascinating secrets and tells the stories of the traitors, rebels and royalty who met their end inside its imposing walls.

Dan is in the heart of the English countryside at Warwick Castle. While it appears idyllic today, for centuries it was a poisoned chalice to the Earls of Warwick who lived there and its walls echo with tales of betrayal, bloodshed and murder.
Historian Dan Jones is in the heart of Snowdonia exploring a stronghold built not only as an impenetrable fortress but also as a lavish royal palace fit for a fairytale - Caernarfon Castle.

Situated high on a crag overlooking the river Forth, Stirling Castle has guarded the gateway to the Scottish Highlands for centuries. The residence of kings, armies and felons, its battle-scarred walls have witnessed savagery and chivalry, intrigue, alchemy, adultery and murder. Location filming, stunning aerial shots and reconstructions bring to life its turbulent history.

Dan Jones explores the turbulent history of Carrickfergus, one of the most ancient castles in Northern Ireland and a stronghold that holds the key to understanding the tempestuous relationship between Britain and Ireland.
Dan Jones visits the heart of the English countryside to explore Arundel Castle and the dramatic history of the Earls of Arundel.

The dramatic moors and valleys of West Yorkshire are the setting for an unusual slice of the past in Tony Robinson's first walk from this new series. This evocative landscape was the home of, and inspiration for, the Brontes, the remarkable literary family that produced Wuthering Heights and Jane Eyre.
Tony Robinson visits the Cairngorms National Park to discover how Queen Victoria and Prince Albert helped to shape Scottish traditions and imagery such as tartan, bagpipes and caber tossing.

Tony Robinson is out to discover why Pembrokeshire feels so English. There are castles everywhere, and it boasts one of the country's finest cathedrals, sure signs that the Normans stamped their mark all over this little slice of Wales.
Tony Robinson visits the British Channel Islands, which were occupied by Nazi Germany for five years between 1940 and 1945.
Tony Robinson visits Sherwood Forest and the Peak District as he sets out to discover the real King John.

Tony Robinson hikes up from Lyme Regis on Dorset's Jurassic Coast to the Somerset Levels in the footsteps of a ragtag rebel army led by the dashing young Duke of Monmouth, the illegitimate son of Charles II.

Ein Ehepaar aus New York mit sieben Kindern will in Roatan ein neues Leben beginnen. Gesucht wird ein großes Grundstück am Strand, das nicht nur genügend Platz für die Familie bietet, sondern auch Mieteinnahmen generiert.

In Arkansas benötigt eine Siedlerfamilie dringend Hilfe. Im Spätwinter schlägt das Wetter in den unwirtlichen Ozark Mountains gnadenlos zu. Ashli und Chris Curry sind die Aufgaben längst über den Kopf gewachsen: Es mangelt an Trinkwasser.

Jay und Pattie Crum haben sich ihren Traum erfüllt und sind auf eine entlegene Ranch mitten in der Wildnis Montanas gezogen. Doch ihr Grundstück ist nur über einen 16 Kilometer langen Feldweg zu erreichen, der regelmäßig von Felsen oder Baumstämmen blockiert wird. Da Jay an Epilepsie leidet, sitzt das Paar bei möglichen medizinischen Notfällen praktisch in der Falle. Die Outdoor-Experten aus Alaska eilen den Crums zur Hilfe, um sie bei der Sicherung ihrer Lebensgrundlage zu unterstützen.

Chase Morrill muss zusammen mit seinem Team in West Bath an einem Auftrag arbeiten. Und die Liste der Aufgaben ist endlos: Fenster, Sanitäranlagen, eine Küche und Schränke - all das für das künftige Urlaubsdomizil von Tina Seners.

Rod Hiltz ist ein Naturbursche. Er genießt die ruhige und entspannende Zeit im Grünen. Das spiegelt auch seine Immobilie wider. Doch es gibt ein Manko: Er muss immer durch den Wald laufen, um zum Plumpsklo zu gelangen. Das soll ein Ende haben.

MJ und Meri Sue wohnen seit Neustem in Austin, Texas. Dort wollen sie ihr Geld darauf konzentrieren, ihre Studiendarlehen abzubezahlen, um schuldenfrei leben zu können. Deswegen suchen sie nach einem Tiny House mit Platz für sich und ihre zwei Hunde.

Die baldige Studentin Sarah sucht in Charleston, South Carolina nach einem Tiny Haus. Ihr Plan ist nämlich, dadurch mietfrei leben zu können, um neben ihrem Studiendarlehen unnötige Schulden vermeiden zu können, dabei aber komplett mobil zu sein.

Eloisa aus Santa Clarita, Kalifornien hat genug von ihrem dreistöckigen Zuhause und wünscht sich nun ein Tiny House im englischen Cottage-Stil. Dieses soll luftig und gemütlich sein sowie ihr Leben auf das Wichtigste reduzieren.

Eine baldige teure Hochzeit und ein militärischer Zeitplan, der sie in kurzer Zeit in verschiedene Städte schicken kann, führen dazu, dass die erwartenden Eltern sich verkleinern wollen. Dazu kaufen sie ein Haus, um günstiger und mobiler zu leben.

Sarah und Jesse aus Seattle haben in einem verheerenden Feuer alles verloren. Deswegen haben sie gelernt, sich mit der minimalistischen Lebensweise zufriedenzustellen und sind deswegen der Meinung, dass ein Tiny Haus für die beiden perfekt ist.

Es klingt so einfach: In ein anderes Land gehen und ein neues Leben anfangen. Das fängt bei einem Haus und die damit verbundenen Bestimmungen sind oft sehr anders als gewohnt. Haussucher blicken auf Baustile, Bürokratie und Besonderheiten.

Es klingt so einfach: In ein anderes Land gehen und ein neues Leben anfangen. Das fängt bei einem Haus und die damit verbundenen Bestimmungen sind oft sehr anders als gewohnt. Haussucher blicken auf Baustile, Bürokratie und Besonderheiten.

Keith und Tarah wollen aus Seattle nach Mexiko. Sie geben viel auf für diesen Traum vom karibischen Flair für wenig Geld. Aber an der Riviera Maya merken sie, dass da noch mehr gefordert ist. Sie müssen sich von mehr trennen als sie erwartet haben.

Für ein attraktives Jobangebot will ein junges Paar nach Belgien ziehen. Der alte Hund soll mit umziehen. Die neue Umgebung lockt, und sie freuen sich auf ein neues Zuhause. Dass der Hund sich dort auch wohlfühlt, ist den beiden sehr wichtig.

Diesmal will ein Paar aus Utah, USA, mit ihrem kleinen Kind nach Neuseeland auswandern. Sie haben eine Arbeitsstelle in der schönen Hafenstadt Timaru finden können. Sie sind gespannt auf das als familienfreundlich beschriebene Umfeld.

Zwei California State Rangers suchen nach 35 Ehejahren ein eigenes Stück Natur, das an ihr Berufsleben erinnert. Parallel dazu wollen eine Tierchiropraktikerin und ein Hufschmied ihre winzige Mietwohnung verlassen, um mehr Platz zu haben.

Ein überarbeiteter Fluglotse hofft mithilfe der Property Brothers auf einen ruhigen Rückzugsort für sich und seine Familie. Gleichzeitig wagen eine angehende Olympionikin und ihre Freundin ein großes Risiko: Gemeinsam wollen sie Land kaufen.

Während Austin auf einer Auktion ist, genießt Elizabeth mit ihren Söhnen einen gemütlichen Morgen auf der Ranch. Sie bereitet dänische Apfelküchlein und gebackene Eier mit Salsa zu, einfache, liebevolle Gerichte, die nach Zuhause schmecken.
Paul und Helen bauen eine Küche, in der neue Geräte mit Antiquitäten kombiniert werden.
Paul und Helen verwandeln einen Teil einer Scheune aus dem 17. Jahrhundert in eine rustikale Küche.

Der ruhige Küstenort Rocky Point liegt auf Long Island. Dort wechseln sich Wald und Strand harmonisch ab, was die Preise der Immobilien in die Höhe treibt. Doch Sara und Justin sind auf der Jagd nach einem Strandhaus für höchstens 450.000 Dollar. Die beiden haben zwei Kinder und wollen ihre Wochenenden als Familie in der Natur verbringen. Das Traumhaus der Familie hat vier Schlafzimmer, zwei Bäder, eine große Küche und einen Garten.

Eine Patchworkfamilie ist auf der Suche nach einem Strandgrundstück in Hampton, Virginia, wo sie ihren Kindern eine schöne Ferienzeit am Meer ermöglichen können. Die Familie sucht ein Objekt mit mindestens zwei Schlafzimmern für Familie und Freunde.
Daphne und Ian möchten mehr Hochzeiten auf ihr Schloss holen und verwandeln dafür die in die Jahre gekommenen Toiletten in luxuriöse Gästeräume.

Daphne und Ian arbeiten mit Hochdruck daran, das Torhaus ihres Schlosses endlich fertigzustellen. Neben einer Galerie mit Blick auf das Schloss entstehen ein auffälliger Kronleuchter und ein maßgefertigter Katzenbaum für Kater Charlie.

Die Kalamas übernehmen ein renovierungsbedürftiges Haus in Manoa und glauben zunächst an einen vielversprechenden Fund. Doch beim Abriss kommen massive Probleme mit den Leitungen, Termitenschäden und eine kostspielige Überraschung zum Vorschein.

Kamohai und Tristyn besichtigen auf O'ahu ein stark verfallenes und vermülltes Haus, das seit 20 Jahren leer steht. Kamohai sieht das Potenzial, es nach der Renovierung für stolze 1,4 Millionen Dollar zu verkaufen und beginnt den Umbau.
Ein verheiratetes Surferpaar sucht in Virginia Beach nach einem bezahlbaren Strandhaus, das zu seinem Lebensstil passt.

Nach der Geburt ihres Kindes möchte ein Paar den eisigen Wintern in Michigan entkommen und sich in Fort Myers Beach in Florida niederlassen. Gesucht wird ein bezahlbares Strandhaus für das neue Familienleben unter Palmen.

Ein junges Paar wünscht sich ein neues Traumhaus mit tollem Ausblick auf Maui. Ihm ist dabei besonders wichtig, dass es einen Garten gibt, der sich zum Obst- und Gemüseanbau eignet. Das Budget liegt bei etwa 1,2 Millionen Dollar.

Susie und Marty träumen bereits seit ihren Flitterwochen davon, aus Seattle wegzuziehen und sich ein neues Leben auf Hawaii aufzubauen. Ihr neues Zuhause soll unbedingt Meerblick, Gästezimmer und einen Pool haben. Das Paar will viel surfen.

Laura kehrt nach 40 Jahren auf dem Festland zurück in ihre Heimat auf Maui. Gemeinsam mit ihrer Schwester sucht sie das perfekte Haus in Strandnähe mit altem Hawaii-Charme. Ihr großzügiges Budget bietet viele Möglichkeiten.

Mike und Masha tauchen für ihr Leben gern. Nun kehren sie nach 25 Jahren nach Hawaii zurück, um sich dort für immer niederzulassen. Auf "Big Island" sucht das sportbegeisterte Paar nach einem Haus am Wasser und mit Garten.

A large piece of land in Ratby in Leicestershire, a terrace in Chesterton in Staffordshire and a 1930s semi with a huge garden and huge potential are all sold at auction. Martin Roberts, Lucy Alexander and Dion Dublin meet the developers hoping to breathe new life into their auction buys.

A two-bedroom detached house in Basford in Nottingham, a top-floor flat in Portsmouth and a large Edwardian terrace in Crewe are all sold under the hammer. Martin, Lucy and Dion meet the new owners and hear about their plans.

A multimillion-pound development in Farningham in Kent, an ambitious, total renovation project in Aspatria in Cumbria and a very small studio flat in Wallington in Surrey are all sold under the hammer. Martin and Lucy meet the new owners to discuss their plans.
A semi in Sutton Coldfield near Birmingham, a derelict house in a rural village near Dover in Kent and a basement without planning permission in Ipswich in Suffolk are all sold under the hammer.

A 20-year-old first-time developer, a banker turned developer and a builder who wants to create a new home for his soon-to-be-wife all buy properties at auction. Martin, Lucy and Dion are in Chesterton, Hornchurch and Sudbrook to hear their plans.

A run-down listed village house in Farningham in Kent is given the wow factor while houses in Great Barr in Birmingham and Crewe in Cheshire are also given great makeovers. Martin, Lucy and Dion meet the new owners and catch up on their progress after the transformations.

Lucy talks to a pastor and his wife who plan to build their dream eco house in Brompton in Kent. Meanwhile, Martin meets a first-time developer in Wolverhampton, and Dion looks at a huge building which already comes with a tenanted flat and a hair salon in Newcastle-under-Lyme.

A commercial and residential building in Beeston in Nottinghamshire, a four-storey house in East Dulwich in London and a flat in Godalming in Surrey are all given high-end makeovers. Will the developers, who all bought at auction, make a profit?

A 1930s semi in Hatfield in Hertfordshire, a flat in Croydon and a workshop and land in Heanor in Derbyshire are sold at auction. Martin, Lucy and Dion meet the owners and hear their plans to make money from their bricks and mortar.

A mum and dad buy a piece of land in Stevenage in Hertfordshire in the hope of developing a pair of houses for their children, a couple who buy a top-floor flat in Motherwell in Scotland want to make a profit on the rent, and two young brothers buy a run-down house in South Normanton.

A bungalow in Langton Green in Kent is given a high-end refurbishment and extension, a father-and-son team cleverly refigure the existing space in a terraced house in Stoke-on-Trent, and two lifelong friends have high hopes for a piece of land they buy behind a house they already own in Northwood in Middlesex.

A 1930s semi in Leamington Spa in Warwickshire, a terraced house in London's Plumstead and a workshop on the Isle of Sheppey in Kent are all sold under the hammer. Martin Roberts, Lucy Alexander and Dion Dublin hear about the plans for the three properties.

Martin Roberts catches up on ambitious plans to redevelop the site of a former school in Ebbw Vale in Wales, while Dion Dublin talks to a first-time developer planning to extend up and out at a semi in Bloxwich in the West Midlands.
A flat in Sutton in London, a studio apartment in Chatham in Kent and a terraced house in Middlesbrough are all sold under the hammer. Martin, Lucy and Dion meet the new owners.

A bungalow in Biggin Hill with huge potential, a centuries-old cottage in a beautiful part of Devon and an end terrace crying out for an upstairs bathroom are all sold under the hammer. Martin, Lucy and Dion meet the new owners and hear their plans.

Martel Maxwell joins the team, and looks at an old mews house in an historic part of Litchfield in Staffordshire, while Martin Roberts assesses the potential of a bungalow in Hanley in Stoke-on-Trent.

Martel Maxwell looks at a large terraced house in Dover in Kent with bags of potential, Martin Roberts is in Camborne in Cornwall viewing a house with lots of issues, and Dion Dublin meets a couple who bought a flat in Woodford Green in Essex.

Martel Maxwell is in Gillingham in Kent meeting a couple embarking on their first renovation development, Martin Roberts talks to a man with ambitious plans for a house in London's Chingford, and Dion Dublin looks round a semi in Wolverhampton.

Martel Maxwell hears development plans for a two-bedroom flat in Godalming in Surrey, Martin Roberts looks at a house in a terrible state of repair in Telford in Shropshire, and Dion Dublin sizes up the work needing to be done at a terraced house in Smethwick in the West Midlands.
A flat with great sea views in Margate in Kent, a bungalow in Whaley Thorns in Nottinghamshire and an end terrace in Longbridge in Birmingham are all sold under the hammer.
A listed building in Brentwood in Essex dating back to the 16th-century is sold under the hammer, along with a flat in Halesowen in Birmingham and an end terrace in Northwood in Stoke-on-Trent.

A large semi in New Barnet in London is bought as an ambitious project to turn into a family home, a family do up a semi in Dover in Kent to make a profit, and two friends club together to try their hand at refurbishing a terraced house in Derby.
