When a storm cancels Peppa and her family's outdoor adventure plans, they decide to bring the fun indoors. Using their imagination, they go sledding, climb a mountain and enjoy a campfire in the attic.
King Thistle is bored in the Royal Castle and takes up the hobby of birdwatching. Using his magic bird book, the King is pleased when another creature makes a nest in the Royal Castle.
King Thistle has a cold and needs some medicine. Nanny Plum, Holly, and Ben, have a lot of fun collecting the ingredients to make a magic potion to cure his cold and make him better.
When Percy and Kana have a near-collision, they enlist Safety Engine Emily and go to ridiculous extremes to introduce safety measures all over Sodor.
When Bulstrode and Cranky get into their crankiest fight yet, they learn how to express their feelings in order to save their friendship.
Dora and Boots help Benny perfect a new move in time for the championship volleyball game. Dora and Boots show Dulce the dragon that everyone's differences are what make them excellent!
Join Tim Rex as he tackles kid-shaped problems with dino-sized solutions in space! Tim and Kai go crater surfing and attempt a cool new trick.
Tim and Kai compete to get Terri's spare Space-Land ticket.
Join Tim Rex as he tackles kid-shaped problems with dino-sized solutions in space! Tim and Kai attempt to rebuild Dad's childhood spaceship.
Mr. Curry is sure there's a monster in the park lake, and Paddington sets out to help him prove it.
The day of Mrs. Cow and Mr. Bull wedding arrives, but not everything goes to plan; nothing stops it being the best wedding ever and there is a lot of happy crying.
Peppa receives an invitation to Candy Cat's birthday party, but a double-decker party bus arrives; the bus goes to the playground and even the beach, hosting the best party ever.

Peppa and friends are at Penny Polar Bear's house for a movie night; before they can watch it, the children need to decide where to sit, which popcorn to eat and take a toilet break -- then they're finally ready.
Granny Sheep and Suzy take Granny Pig and Peppa around Art House Day; after a day full of screen printing and silhouette miniatures, Granny Pig finds an art piece at Suzy's house.

After Peppa and family visit a tourist spot with her new friend Birgit Bear, the caravan unhooks from the car. The bear family stops it just in time, and they finish the day jumping muddy puddles at the caravan park.
At Chloe's birthday party, the children and grownups struggle to finish the inflatable obstacle course to reach the prize.
A cake sale is organised to mend the magic school, but Queen Thistle is baking and no one can eat her cakes.
Wandy gets a cold and is taken ill; Holly is given a replacement wand. This new wand can do lots of things that Wandy can't, and soon becomes the favourite.
Peppa and George are re-enacting the Apollo Moon Landing with the help of Granny Pig's friends. Grampy Rabbit lends them his rocket, but no one has told him it's just pretend.
When George loses the metal wind-up key for his toy robot in the long grass, Grandpa Pig cannot find his metal detector to help George track it down.
Peppa and her friends have fun while painting in the playgroup. Madame Gazelle then teaches them how to play games with parachutes.
It's the day of the London Marathon! Peppa and family come to cheer Daddy on. Peppa and George see many runners dressed in funny costumes - and then they spot Daddy!
Peppa is intrigued to see her parents go to work every day. Daddy Pig makes Peppa her very own office to make her feel good.
Peppa and George check out Grandpa's new Bug Hotel as lots of insects arrive. A bumblebee cannot find a place in the hotel because the rooms are too small for him.

Madame Gazelle presents the poetry to Peppa and her friends, explaining that sounds can also be poems. When it starts raining, the inspired children create a beautiful poem about the rain and recite it to their parents.
Peppa, George, Molly Mole and Freddy Fox play in the garden. Molly digs a tunnel and hits a box of pirate treasure.
At playgroup, Madame Gazelle has invited Mr Potato to lead Peppa and her friends in a wonderfully fun musical Kiddie Workout.
Mr Bull builds a brand-new clubhouse and slide for Peppa and her friends.

Peppa and her family are visiting Cousin Chloe's house to play with Baby Alexander. Peppa thinks she knows all about babies because she already looks after her doll, and George is a baby too, though he disagrees.
Peppa, George, Granny and Grandpa Pig visit the sailing club where they find a juke box. They have fun dancing to all different types of music.
Peppa and her friends visit Mrs Badger's petting farm, where they enjoy feeding the chickens and meeting cute guinea pigs.
Peppa's family embarks on an adventure, but Daddy Pig's fear of heights threatens their climb to the monkey tree.
Peppa is playing with Candy Cat when Emily Elephant's Granny moves out of the flat. When the new neighbours arrive, Peppa recognises her holiday friend Rohan Rhino.

While visiting Suzy and Emily's house, Peppa is surprised that there are extra rules which she does not have in her own house. On the drive home, Peppa explains to Mummy Pig that different houses have different rules.

Mummy Pig takes Peppa to the doctors for her yearly health check-up with Dr Polar Bear, who checks her height, weight, ears, mouth and heartbeat and listens to Mummy tell him all about the changes Peppa has gone through.
Peppa and her friends visit the cinema for the first time to watch the 'Super Potato' film.
Peppa and George play at Granny and Grandpa's house and have a fun dinosaur party.
Peppa helps out with Danny Dog refurbishing his bedroom, and imagines a pirate adventure along the way.
Grandpa Pig finds his night at the hospital so comfortable, he's reluctant to be discharged. Papa and Suzy volunteer to nurse him at home and make sure he's just as comfortable as he was in hospital.
Peppa and her friends are at their clubhouse. They decide to start a detective club, and when Daddy Pig loses his car keys, they have a real mystery to solve.
While Mummy Pig is enjoying a spa day out, Daddy, George and Peppa explore the rest of the shopping centre.
Mummy Pig shows Peppa how to play pretend by teaching her how to wink. Zoe Zebra comes to play with Peppa and brings along her toy monkey. Peppa pretends Monkey has a cough.
Peppa and her family go bowling at the Peppatown Bowling Alley.
Peppa and her friends visit a roller disco organised by Madame Gazelle. After skating along to nursery rhymes, they go wild to the rhythm of the music together with Madame Gazelle.
Peppa and her friends learn how to animate their drawings at playgroup.
Peppa and George join Grandma Piggy and her friends to play a game pretending to be Vikings. The Vikings enjoy Grandpa Piggy's boat until they realise they forgot about the picnic.
Peppa learns that Mummy Pig used to keep a diary when she was her age, so Peppa decides to give it a try.
Peppa and her friends and family are looking forward to a trip to the seaside where they can make sandcastles, but when they arrive at the beach there is too much snow.
Mrs Zebra teaches Peppa, George, Zoe, Zaza and Zuzu Zebra how to make a real tea set from clay.

Daddy Pig loves to watch television, but Peppa Pig thinks that he needs to do some exercise. She says that Daddy Pig's tummy is looking a bit big. Daddy Pig disagrees but says that Peppa can be in charge of getting him fit. Peppa gives him lots of exercises to do, and Daddy Pig is exhausted by the end of the day.
Peppa and her family visit Uncle Pig, Aunty Pig and Cousin Chloe. Chloe has a new puppet theatre, and she helps Peppa and George to make puppets. After lunch, they put on a very funny puppet show.
When it comes to pancake making, Daddy Pig thinks he is a bit of an expert, but he has a tendency to flip the pancakes a bit too high.
George, Peppa and Mummy Pig head off to Miss Rabbit's clothes shop to get George some brand-new clothes. After trying on lots of new exciting outfits George finds an outfit that suits him just right!
At the park, all the leaves have turned red and yellow, and it's so windy that Peppa's ball blows into the pond and George's hat blows into a tree.
Peppa and George go ice skating, but they have never been before, and Peppa keeps falling over.
Peppa and her family have been on a trip to a mountain beauty spot. When Daddy Pig loses the car keys down a drain, Mr Bull offers to find them with his digger.
While enjoying a tea break, Mr Bull accidentally breaks his delicate teapot. He takes the pieces to Miss Rabbit in the hope that she can mend it.
Peppa is feeling unwell and Doctor Brown Bear says she must stay in bed. Peppa's friends come to cheer her up.
Peppa and family go camping, but soon realise that their tent is too small for everyone, so Daddy sleeps underneath the stars.
Grandpa Pig takes Peppa and George to the playground, but does not understand the children's rules.
Suzy and Peppa start a Secret Club where they go on secret missions, and do secret things, but soon everyone wants to join.
Doctor Hamster is rushed off her feet when nearly all the animals need her help on the same day.

Granny and Grandpa Pig have been growing strawberries to make jam, but the birds have eaten all the fruit. They decide to go and pick their own at Miss Rabbit's strawberry farm, but Granny and Grandpa eat too many strawberries and end up very full.
Peppa and her friends visit the Little Cars Play Centre where Miss Rabbit is in charge, and they get to drive little toy cars.
Mr Bull builds a brand-new clubhouse and slide for Peppa and her friends.
The children learn about the weather, there is a new friend for Peppa, and Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa's where Grandpa Pig is making a Rock Garden.
Mandy Mouse has a birthday visit to a cheese theme park with Peppa and her friends. Everything in the park is cheese-themed, and Mandy loves cheese.
Inspired by Granny Pig's stories of ancient Rome, Peppa and George decide to design the mosaic of a dinosaur with pebbles, and learn a little Latin.
Peppa and her family have gone on holiday, staying in a teeny tiny little holiday home near the beach. They discover that even when it rains, they can have lots of fun.
Peppa and all her friends are having a sleep-over, with different friends in each of the four different flats in the high street. They decide to play hide and seek across all the rooms.

While Mummy Pig is at work, Peppa, George and Daddy make the best out of not being able to use the computer by tidying the kitchen, and when they find a jelly mould, they decide to make a nice surprise for their busy mum.
Grandpa and Granny Pig dust off their motorbike and sidecar to take Peppa and George on a trip. They go to the beach and camp in a tent that folds out of the sidecar.
Peppa Pig and Suzy Sheep are spending the day with Doctor Hamster, and they are learning about what vets do. Doctor Hamster says she's glad to have two helpers with her and calls the next patient.
While at a playgroup with Madame Gazelle, Peppa and her friends learn all about the weather by building themselves a Weather Station, complete with thermometer, wind turbine and rain collector.
Peppa and George play at Granny and Grandpa Pig's house. Grandma, Peppa and George go to the shed to see what Grandpa is doing and discover that he's built a robot.

Mummy and Daddy take Peppa and George for a day out at the botanical gardens. Miss Rabbit is there to greet them and show them around. There's the hot house, the cold house, the rainforest garden and the laboratory where Mr Rabbit creates new varieties of flowers. Last of all, there is the children's garden, which has another water feature... mud!
Peppa and her friends play some very active games in the garden.
Madame Gazelle teaches the children how to play the recorder. They practise a lot at home, then put on a performance for all the parents to enjoy.
Peppa, George and Daddy Pig visit the charity shop to sell things they don't need, and things they may need.
Mum, Dad, Peppa and George decide to go to the beach on a beautiful sunny day. Suddenly, a little cloud covers the sun for a minute, but then it passes and the sun reappears.
Peppa and Suzy are excited about the sleepover and sit up in bed talking about what they will do when they grow up.
Peppa and George have fun in the snow, as they make footprints, snowballs and build a snowman.
Mummy Pig has a lovely new picture of Peppa and George, so Daddy Pig offers to put it up, but it's not as simple as Daddy Pig thought, and he makes a very big hole in the wall.
Goldie the fish does not look happy and is not eating her food. Peppa, George, and Mummy Pig take her on a bus trip to visit Dr Hamster the vet.

Peppa has a new pen pal, a little donkey from France named Delphine. Peppa receives letters from Delphine Donkey and speaks to her on the telephone. Although Peppa speaks English and Delphine speaks French, they discover that they love lots of the same things, especially jumping up and down in muddy puddles.
Granny Pig is really pleased with all the plastic gnomes and wishing well she's got for the garden. Peppa and George love them too, but Grandpa Pig wishes they would all disappear.

Mummy and Daddy Pig let Peppa and George put their coats on over their pyjamas and go outside to look at the stars. With the help of a telescope, Daddy Pig teaches Peppa and George how to find the North Star.

When a fishing trip goes wrong, leaving Grandpa Pig and Grampy Rabbit stranded on a desert island, Captain Daddy Dog is the only one able to save them. It makes him realise that he misses the sea after all.
Peppa loves secrets, so Mummy Pig makes her a special box to put secret things in.

Peppa's best friend, Suzy Sheep, comes to play at Peppa's house for the afternoon. Peppa won't allow George to join in. When Peppa and Suzy want to play doctors and nurses, George is delighted to be the patient.
Granny and Grandpa Pig come for a dinner party with Mummy and Daddy Pig. Peppa and George are too tired to go to bed until they are told a story.
Daddy Pig winds up the old cuckoo clock in Peppa and George's bedroom. When the clock strikes the hour, a wooden bird pops out, flapping its wings and singing 'Cuckoo'.
Daddy teaches the children how to play basketball, and it is not long before they are good enough to take on a much bigger team.
Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig take Peppa and George to play in the playground. On the way it starts to get foggy, and before long it becomes so foggy that they can't see anything.

The Detective introduces his new friend, the superhero Super Potato, who teaches children the importance of eating fruit and vegetables every day, and later helps the Detective out of a complicated situation.
Peppa and the Pig family attend a school fête. Peppa's favourite things at the fête are face painting, the balloons, and the bouncy castle.
Everyone in Peppa's town is excited to meet Mr Potato when he comes to open a new sports centre.
Peppa and George want to jump in muddy puddles, but Mummy tells them to go in the pool instead.
Madame Gazelle sets the children a creative task of making masks. There are carrot masks, robot masks, and even pretty butterfly masks. The only thing missing is lots and lots of glitter.
Madame Gazelle takes the children to Grampy Rabbit's gym class, where they learn how to be real explorers.
Grandpa Pig is planting seeds to make a flower garden, but the birds keep eating them, so Peppa and George help Grandpa Pig to make a scarecrow, which stops the birds eating Grandpa's seeds.
To celebrate Freddy Fox's birthday, the children go on a trip to a Dinosaur Park. With Grampy Rabbit as their leader, they follow dinosaur footprints to find Freddy's birthday treat.
The playgroup visits a nature reserve, specialising in tiny insects, bugs, and butterflies. So Pedro brings along his pet stick insect.
Mandy Mouse joins Peppa's playgroup. She uses a wheelchair and is super sporty. The children have a lot of fun playing together.
Peppa and her family enjoy the apple tree at the top of the hill. It has a swing on it that they all like to swing on and Peppa has a special song for it.
Grampy Rabbit gives Peppa and her friends a tour of an exercise park. Since the machines are only for grownups, the kids do funny exercises instead.
Granny and Grandpa Pig are taking Peppa and George to a festival, a jigsaw festival. Peppa learns the secrets of puzzles from Grandma Donkey.

Peppa and George are watching a television show about Detective Potato and how he helps people find things. Daddy needs to buy some gravel so Peppa and George go with him. They park the car in a very large car park, but when they return, they can't remember where they parked it. Police Officer Panda and Police Officer Squirrel arrive to help Daddy Pig but have no luck. Suddenly, Detective Potato appears and saves the day.
Peppa, George and Freddy Fox are mistaken for pirates while sailing on the river with Grandpa Pig. When the truth is revealed, officers Panda and Squirrel invite them for a ride in their police boat.
During a picnic in her garden, cousin Chloe shows Peppa and George fun things to do with flowers.
Auntie, Uncle Pig, and cousin Chloe are coming for dinner and Peppa is allowed to join too! Peppa is very proud of staying up late; she even stayed up later than the Daddies!
After finding out Daddy Pig has a place in the London Marathon, Peppa and George help Daddy Pig become stronger with lots of different, though not all typical, exercises.
Mummy Pig and Peppa are at Granny Pig's house. They find Mummy's old patchwork quilt that Granny made for her as a baby. Peppa decides she'd like to make one for the baby!
Madame Gazelle needs to go to the dentist and Bull takes over Peppa's class. As the children already know the suggested themes, Bull decides to show them how to fix a floorboard that is creaking.
Mummy and Daddy Pig show Peppa and George how to play flying discs in the park. Soon their friends appear with their parents.
Peppa finds a small bird on the ground in the garden of her house. She takes him to Dr Hamster, who explains that it is a swift and is probably tired after a long journey.

Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig, Peppa and George go to the skate park with their bicycles, scooters and skateboards. While Peppa has fun playing around on Daddy's skateboard, she soon learns that he is more of an expert than she realised.
Mr Labrador is here in his new ice cream van. It is his first day selling ice creams. In fact, Mr Labrador loves ice cream, perhaps a little too much.

Everyone is down at the lake as it's a perfect day to go boating. Miss Rabbit has all sorts of boats for hire and Daddy Pig picks one with pedals, but when all the families have a race, he soon wishes he had picked something easier to sail.
Grandpa Pig hides some pirate treasure in his garden, and when Peppa and George come, they have to look for it, using a map and following the clues.
When the family goes to Granny and Grandpa Pig's house for dinner, George is reluctant to eat his salad.

After Peppa's tooth falls out, Mummy Pig explains that the Tooth Fairy will come that very night to take the tooth and leave a shiny coin in its place. Peppa plans to stay awake all night to see the Tooth Fairy.

It's time for playgroup, and Peppa and friends are thinking about what they want to be when they grow up. Some in the group want to be nurses, police officers and even pirates, but Peppa takes a little while to figure out what she wants to be.
Grandpa Pig pops round with some seeds for Peppa and George to plant, with Daddy Pig helping out by acting as a scarecrow.

Peppa and George love jumping in muddy puddles, even when it's raining, but when George takes off his rain hat he catches a cold. After plenty of rest and some warm milk and honey, George begins to feel much better.

Grandpa and Granny Pig show and share with Peppa and George their toys and hobbies. Granny shows her special doll from childhood and Grandpa his love of building toy planes. Peppa and George have great fun when Grandpa reveals his new biggest plane ever that even George can fit in.

Daddy Pig takes Peppa and George to school on their scooters. When he decides that it would be quicker to ride back, he discovers that riding scooters is great fun. Mummy Pig thinks that they are fun too and they both ride the scooters.

George eats his breakfast too quickly and gets hiccups, so Peppa tries to help him get rid of them. After trying everything else, there is only one solution left for Peppa to cure him with - to scare him!
Peppa's playgroup is putting on a play, and Peppa is going to be Little Red Riding Hood.
When Mummy Pig helps out at Miss Rabbit's fire station, she is called upon to douse the flames at Daddy Pig's out-of-control barbecue.
Zoe Zebra delivers a very special letter for Peppa and George, an invitation to her birthday party.
Peppa and her family visit a new theme park where there is lots of fun to be had with vegetables.
Peppa's friend Pedro wears glasses, and Peppa thinks she might need them too, so Mummy Pig takes her to the optician.
Tiddles gets stuck in a tree and needs to be rescued. When the turtle falls on Pedro's nose, he needs to go to the doctors to make sure everything is OK.
Daddy Pig reads Peppa and George a bedtime story to help them fall asleep. When George wakes up again, Peppa has to make up a bedtime story to get him back to sleep.

Mummy Pig shows Peppa and her friend Suzy Sheep some old photographs from when they were babies. Peppa and Suzy don't remember being that young, but they are pleased to see that they have always been best friends.
It's bedtime, but Peppa is not sleepy, so Daddy Pig tells Peppa and George a story about a pretty princess and a dinosaur.
Daddy Pig has a book from the library that he has kept for too long. The family go to the library to return it and find more books to read.
Peppa and George go sailing with Grandpa Pig, but when he keeps getting stuck in the mud, they all decide to have a sleepover on the boat while they wait for the tide to come back in.
When Daddy Pig needs a new watch, Mr Fox finds three grandfather clocks in the back of his van. Three clocks are much better than one. Mr Fox has everything in his van, even a chicken.
Peppa and George want to be famous detectives like their favourite television programme 'Detective Potato', so Daddy Pig gives them a mystery to solve.

It's Richard Rabbit's birthday party and George is invited. That can only mean one thing, soft play. George and friends have great fun, swinging, bouncing and climbing, but it isn't quite as much fun for the grown-ups.
Peppa and George meet Kylie Kangaroo and her brother Joey. Peppa shows Kylie how to jump up and down in muddy puddles, and they see who can jump the highest.
The playgroup is going on an outing to the museum. Everyone is on the bus ready to go, except Pedro Pony, so where is he?

Peppa, George and Daddy Pig are excited about Mummy Pig's birthday and have lots of fun preparing surprises for her. When Mummy Pig sees her beautiful cake and opens her present, she is absolutely delighted.
At Peppa's playgroup, Madame Gazelle wants everyone to show the class their special talent.

Peppa and George's toy basket is full, and their beds are covered in toys, so Mummy Pig decides it is time to order a new toy cupboard. The cupboard arrives in the post, but it needs to be assembled - and Mummy and Daddy Pig are not very good at DIY. Luckily help is at hand, as Mr Zebra the Postman loves assembling flat-pack furniture.

Mummy Rabbit comes to visit with a big tummy. Everyone is excited to find out there is a baby rabbit inside, but they are in for an even bigger surprise! The children think of ideas for names beginning with 'R.'

Grandpa and Granny Pig take Peppa, George and all their friends on a boat trip to Pirate Island. On the island, Grandpa shows everyone how to use his metal detector to find treasure, and they all build a big sandcastle.

Peppa and family have all gone to the caves for a day out and Grampy Rabbit is their tour guide. Peppa and George are excited to see the pretty caves and go through the underground lakes. Daddy Pig must be at his bravest on this trip to go on the scary 'Ride of Doom'.
Miss Rabbit takes Peppa and the family to Granny and Grandpa Pig's house to drop off their shopping, but that's not the last trip of the day for her.
Granny and Grandpa Pig have a beautiful little boat, and Peppa and George are spending the day on the river with them.

It is school project time for Peppa and her friends, which means they have to build castles and bring them into playgroup. Mummy and Daddy Pig have lots of fun helping Peppa make hers, if only they could find the glitter.
Peppa and her playgroup friends go with Madame Gazelle to visit Pedro Pony, who is poorly in hospital.

It is time for a day out and Peppa, George, Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig and Suzy Sheep all go to visit Tiny Land. They see tiny dinosaurs, their favourite tiny landmarks and even a tiny Miss Rabbit doing even more jobs.
Peppa and George help Mummy Pig tidy up the breakfast things. Mummy Pig teaches them how to recycle the bottles and newspapers, then they take everything to Miss Rabbit at the recycling plant.
Peppa and her family visit a museum, and Peppa likes the Kings and Queens room, whereas George's favourite is the dinosaur room.
Peppa's family is staying at Cousin Chloe's house. It's been a long day and everyone is tired and sleepy, but baby Alexander keeps everyone awake with his crying.
When Grandpa Pig puts up a tent in his garden, Peppa and her friends decide that it's a perfect place to put on a circus. With Peppa as the ringmaster, the show can begin.
Peppa and George are playing in the garden when they hear a strange noise. It's thunder. Peppa and George are a little bit frightened at first but Peppa soon decides that she loves thunderstorms.
Peppa and her family spot a rainbow when they go for a drive.
Peppa and her family are trying to get to the playground, but Mr Bull's roadworks are in the way.
Granny and Grandpa's pet Polly Parrot comes to stay, and Peppa and George love Polly Parrot. But when she flies away, no one knows what to do.

In der Schule führt die Theatergruppe das Stück "Romeo und Julia" auf. Dabei soll Arnold die Rolle von Romeo übernehmen. Helga möchte nun unbedingt die Rolle der Julia erhalten. Schließlich wird bei dem Stück richtig viel geküsst.

Bei einem Eltern-Turnier tritt Arnold mit Oma und Opa gegen Helgas Vater Big Bob Pataki an. Am ersten Tag steckt Arnold eine Niederlage ein. Als er erfährt, was tatsächlich mit seinen Eltern passiert ist, schöpft er Hoffnung und besiegt Big Bob.

Arnold möchte Eugene helfen, die Einladungen zu verschicken. Doch die kommen nie an, weswegen Arnold der einzige Partygast bleibt. Stinky schafft es bei einem Landwirtschafts-Wettbewerb, den größten Kürbis zu züchten und zu gewinnen.

Helga hat einen Gutschein für ein Restaurant bekommen. Sie lädt Arnold, Phoebe und Gerald ein, mit ihr kultiviert essen zu gehen. Phoebe ist so schlau, dass Lehrer Simmons beschließt, sie eine Klasse überspringen zu lassen.

Sid, Stinky und Harold entblößen ihre Hinterteile vor dem Rektor und bleiben unerkannt. Arnold muss nachsitzen, weil er seine Freunde nicht verraten möchte. Olga versucht, ihrer Schwester Helga näherzukommen, und begleitet sie in die Schule.

Sid bittet Arnold um Hilfe, weil er Schulden bei Gino hat. Arnold erwirkt, dass sein Freund seine Schuld beim Gangster abarbeiten kann. Der grobe Jamie O ist wie ausgewechselt. Er hat sich verliebt, aber sein Schwarm macht sich über ihn lustig.

Big Bob erleidet einen Hexenschuss. Fortan übernimmt Miriam seine Geschäfte, und das ziemlich gut. Oskar nimmt sich vor, endlich lesen zu lernen. Aber weil er zu faul ist, um wirklich zu lernen, lässt er sich alles vorlesen, bis er es auswendig kann.

Arnold erzählt seinen Freunden eine Gruselgeschichte von einem kopflosen Kutscher im Park. Es ist Freitag, der Dreizehnte. Arnold glaubt nicht daran, dass dieser Tag verflixt ist. Wolfgang und seine Kumpels wollen Arnold einen Streich spielen.

Big Bob kauft sich einen Papagei. Weil dieser ihm aber nach kurzer Zeit auf die Nerven geht, stellt er ihn in Helgas Zimmer. Arnold und Gerald wollen Schoko-Schildkröten verkaufen, müssen dafür aber den Pfadfindern beitreten.

Die Mütter von SpongeBob, Herrn Krabs und Okto besuchen die Krosse Krabbe und übernehmen prompt die Leitung, was dazu führt, dass die Crew faul wird. Patrick ist auf der Suche nach einem Haustier und findet den Stein seiner Träume.

Plankton und Karen nehmen gemeinsam Tanzstunden und werden schnell die Besten im Kurs. SpongeBob findet ein Zauberbuch, welches für reichlich Chaos sorgt. Denn er nutzt dieses, um in der Küche der Krossen Krabbe verschiedenes zu kochen.

Um pünktlich zur Arbeit in der Krossen Krabbe zu sein, zieht SpongeBob dorthin um, doch er stört dort das Geschäft. Als Plankton die Heizung der Krossen Krabbe herunterdreht, wandelt SpongeBob den gefrorenen Boden in eine Schlittschuhbahn um.
In der Krossen Krabbe findet ein Talentwettbewerb statt und Thaddäus übernimmt die Planung.

SpongeBob und Patrick wollen die neue und größte Achterbahn der Welt im Freizeitpark Handschuhland fahren, aber bekommen es mit der Angst zu tun. Plankton bringt SpongeBob, Patrick und Thaddäus dazu, ihm bei der Renovierung zu helfen.

SpongeBob ist hoffnungslos verliebt in die Krabbenburgerin Burgina, doch diese Liebe kann nur von kurzer Dauer sein. Thaddäus wandelt sich nach einem elektrischen Schlag in einen fröhlichen, netten Tintenfisch, was SpongeBob überhaupt nicht zusagt.

Mr. Krabs möchte gerne mit seinem Geld sprechen können und verkauft dafür seine Seele. Thaddäus will SpongeBob durch eine Burgerbratmaschine ersetzen, das kann der nicht auf sich sitzen lassen. Thaddäus will einen Tanzwettbewerb gewinnen.

SpongeBob ist ein Star, denn er wurde von einem berühmten Restaurantkritiker positiv bewertet. Patrick liest eine Anzeige von einer Plattenfirma und will sofort selbst ein Lied machen. Er schickt sein Gedicht hin und bald hört man sein Lied überall.

Sandy hat einen Floh aus Texas in Bikini Bottom eingeschleppt, der Chaos auslöst. Patrick findet einen Donut und weiß nicht, ob er ihn essen kann. SpongeBob bekommt Ärger mit Mr. Krabs, weil auf einem Teller noch ein Schmutzfleck ist.

Mr. Krabs hat eine neue Geschäftsidee und füllt eine alte Vorratsdose bei einem großen Event mit Erinnerungsstücken für die Nachwelt, dort landen auch SpongeBob und Thaddäus und werden begraben. SpongeBob und Patrick treiben Thaddäus in den Wahnsinn.

Crusher versucht immer wieder, Blaze mit fiesen Tricks aus dem Rennen zu schmeißen, doch er findet immer einen Weg, um dem zu entgehen. Auch mit dem riesigen Matschwerfer kann sich Blaze messen und fährt am Ende das große Rennen.

Die Kinder im Camp treffen zwei ländliche Narwale namens Narlene und Nobby. Die Narwale bereiten den Kindern eine süße Überraschung. An einem regnerischen Tag spielen SpongeBob und seine Freunde drinnen Dachdeckerarbeiten.

SpongeBob entsorgt in der Stadt den ganzen Abfall, bis auf einen sturen Müll-Ball // SpongeBob und Mr. Krabs versuchen in Perlas Schule Krabbenburger zu servieren, ohne von der strengen Küchenchefin erwischt zu werden.
SpongeBob und Patrick suchen Thaddäus, nachdem sich sein Haus in einen Müllberg verwandelt hat.

In ihren Gruselgeschichten erzählt Mrs. Withers von Mins Begegnung mit einer mysteriösen Doppelgängerin, wie Will die Toastpokalypse abwendet, wie Jack und Lily das falsche Haustier beerdigen und wie die Kinder in ein Videospiel gezogen werden.

Halmoni verliebt sich in den Hund eines Kunden. Statt ihn zurückzugeben, entführt sie ihn und flieht. Jack bietet an, den Pflegesalon für einen Tag alleine zu führen, aber als eine Schlange Chaos verursacht, muss er die anderen Haustiere retten.

Stein fordert Schere zu einem Bowlingspiel heraus, bei dem es um viel Geld geht. Als Stein bei einem Persönlichkeitsquiz das schlechteste Ergebnis erhält, versucht er allen zu beweisen, dass er weiß, wer er wirklich ist.

Papier will die Aufmerksamkeit seiner Freunde gewinnen, als diese mit Steins Freundin Kartoffel fasziniert sind. Die Freunde von Papier erfahren, dass dieser keine Pups-Witze mag. Daher nehmen sie sich vor, ihn damit zum Lachen zu bringen.

Lincoln soll ein Referat über seine Familie halten. Allerdings gefährdet der Schulweg seinen Vortrag. Lincoln hat das Glück und darf das Urlaubsziel der Familie Loud bestimmen. Klar, dass seine Schwestern ihn beeinflussen wollen, wo es nur geht.

Lincoln kauft sich Ohrstöpsel, damit er seine Ruhe haben kann. Allerdings bringt ihn diese akustische Abwesenheit in eine missliche Lage. Lynn zieht nach einem Streit mit Lucy bei Lincoln ein. Allerdings will er sein Zimmer nicht mit ihr teilen.

Lincolns Eltern haben bald Hochzeitstag, weshalb er ihnen ein Familienfoto schenken möchte. Doch seine Schwestern haben auch noch ein Wörtchen mitzureden. Lincolns Schwestern sind davon genervt, dass er immer bloß in Unterhose bekleidet Comics liest.

Lincoln kauft sich zum Planschen einen kleinen Pool. Doch seine schöne Vorstellung vom entspannten Baden wird von seinen Schwestern gestört. Lincoln will Baby Lily für seine Hobbys begeistern. Aber er ist nicht der Einzige, der um ihre Gunst buhlt.
Lincoln bekommt das alte Mädchenfahrrad von seinen Schwestern und schämt sich dafür.

Thaddäus betreibt nebenbei Bildhauerei. Er versucht mit seinen Werken berühmt zu werden. Doch zu seinem Entsetzen wird stattdessen Patrick als kreatives Genie entdeckt. Das kann Thaddäus partout nicht auf sich sitzen lassen.

Das Sinfonieorchester von Bikini Bottom veranstaltet einen Kompositionswettbewerb und Thaddäus macht auch mit. Er kann sich jedoch kaum konzentrieren, weil SpongeBob und Patrick lautstark Arzt spielen. Das hinterlässt Spuren.
Patrick muss in einen Laden gehen, um einen Coupon für ein Eis einzulösen. Mr. Krabs kauft Thaddäus ein Kunstwerk ab. Doch das ist nichts wert, solange der Künstler noch unter den Lebenden weilt.

Der Männergesangsverein von Bikini Bottom hat einen freien Platz zu vergeben und Thaddäus ist interessiert. Doch dabei ist er nicht der Einzige. Auch SpongeBob glaubt, dass er Talent hätte. Die beiden werden zu Konkurrenten.
Mr. Krabs kauft Thaddäus ein Kunstwerk ab und versucht, Profit daraus zu schlagen.

Plankton wurde endlich aus dem Gefängnis freigelassen, doch führt schon wieder etwas im Schilde. Er schleimt sich bei SpongeBob an, um ihm das Geheimrezept für die Krabbenburger zu entlocken. Doch dieser lässt sich nicht beirren.

Billy will seinem Freund Steve helfen, Mitglied der T-Force zu werden. Phoebe und Max schauen sich den Bewerber genauer an und erfahren, dass seine einzige Fähigkeit darin besteht, Marshmallows zu rösten. Steve nimmt die Ablehnung nicht gut auf.

Die Thundermans kriegen Besuch von High Tide, dem ehemaligen Beschützer von Secret Shores. Doch als sie ihm erklären, dass sie die neuen Helden der Stadt sind, will High Tide seinen alten Job zurück und bringt Jinx und Booch in Gefahr.

Als Schere einen Tannenzapfen verschluckt, nutzt Bleistift einen Origami-Roboter, um in seinen Magen zu gelangen. Schere sieht einen Film über einen Underdog, der trotz aller Widrigkeiten Football-Star wird, und versucht es ihm gleichzutun.

Schere, Stein und Papier sind schockiert zu entdecken, dass die Ratten Bros in ihrer Freizeit Kinder unterrichten, was ihr Weltbild erschüttert. Die beiden Gruppen treten darauf in einem Altruistik-Duell gegeneinander an.

Patrick veranstaltet eine besondere Preisverleihung, aber Grandma Tentacles hasst Preisverleihungen und versucht, die Show zu sabotieren. Es ist Thanksgiving und Patrick schaut sich mit Octina einen besonderen Film im Fernsehen an.

Pinky befürchtet, dass sich Sackenhack komplett verändern könnte und will jeglichen Fortschritt aufhalten. Pinky glaubt, dass er sein Potenzial als Hotdog nicht ausschöpft und will darum eine neue Fähigkeit lernen: Sarkasmus.
SpongeBob durchlebt eine Pechsträhne, als seine glücksbringende Krawattenklammer plötzlich verschwindet. // Als Patrick nicht einschlafen kann, bittet er den Sandmann um Hilfe.

Die Pfadfinder verkaufen Kekse, um sich eine Marsreise zu finanzieren. Mr. Krabs schließt sich ihnen an und startet einen Wettbewerb. Mrs. Puff ist auf SpongeBobs Hilfe angewiesen, um sich nicht von der Konkurrenz ausstechen zu lassen.
Thaddäus fängt als Manager in der Würstchenbude an. SpongeBob bleibt in einem Aufzug stecken.
Das Team der Krossen Krabbe versucht Krabbenburger auf den Tribünen eines Konzerts zu verkaufen.

Als Kunden ihre Haustiere in der Krossen Krabbe füttern, steht Mr. Krabs vor einer Entscheidung. Er muss sich entscheiden, ob er Leute oder Haustiere bedienen möchte. Karen schließt den Abfalleimer, als Plankton wieder eine Verabredung ruiniert.

Weil Patrick sich als Wurm ausgibt, kommt er ins Tierheim und kann nur raus, wenn SpongeBob ihn richtig erziehen kann. Nachdem die Band vom 1000-Taubenüsschen-Nusseis-Partyboot gefeuert wird, versuchen SpongeBob und Patrick sie wieder zu vereinen.

The family is excited to take Jack to Lake World, Lily's favourite theme park. However, after a disappointing day, they discover Lily's favourite ride has vanished. The children must embark on a thrilling adventure to find it and save their holiday.

The family get stuck in a traffic jam that leads to all human civility getting thrown out the passenger side window. Jack and Lily attempt to catch a legendary town fish despite horror stories from townsfolk who have tried and failed before them.

In order to get Theodore to do his bidding, Alvin tells him that he has secret powers and can turn rubbish into candy; when the chipmunks find a baby bird that has fallen from its nest, Alvin is reluctant to get too attached.

Brittany takes up painting to impress her fashion idol, but her idol only likes her art after Alvin ruins it; Alvin is convinced that Julie and her son are trying to move in to their home, so he tries to stop the invasion.

After Max is dumped, Phoebe tries to cheer him up by introducing him to another girl. However, Max's date turns out to be an intense animal activist, who steals Dr Colosso when she sees Max's cruel treatment of him.
Max and Phoebe use their powers to give their friend a confidence boost, but the gesture backfires when he recklessly starts to think that he has superpowers of his own.
When Piper gets a mysterious illness, Captain Man must travel back in time to the 1700s to find the only cure.
Henry gets a series of mysterious notes from someone and worries that this person may know his secret identity.
It's the Chahuta's chilli eating contest, and soon it's revealed Marcel's a cheat. When Hope takes Gran Gran's special ladle to the park to play, it ends up at Professor Lopez's archaeological dig.
Stan claims to have a real Marsupilami appearing in a show he's putting on, but it's a fake robot. Acu thinks a fish-loving alien is in town, and Mica offers to help him track it down.
Lily and Farmer Smurf must investigate a monster that roams the village and turns the Smurfs into zombies.
Gargamel transforms Rowena into Smurfette in an attempt to capture Smurfs, but his mother begins adoring her because she reminded her of her doll from her childhood.
Rowena enchants Voltaire, compelling his obedience; Jokey's prank backfires, resulting in all Smurfs being transformed into pebbles.
Alvin sounds the alarm when he believes Theodore has joined a motorcycle gang of vampires; When Brittany declines Alvin's help for a talent show, he convinces Jeanette to enter, putting them at odds.

After a big fight with Miss Miller, Miss Croner hides out in the chipmunk's treehouse to make Miss Miller worried; Alvin bets Simon that time travelling is possible and hires an actor to pose as one, but a real one shows up.

Paper and Sandpaper are on a train that gets hijacked by The Algebra Villain, who will make them crash unless Paper solves an algebra problem. Rock and Scissors think of the perfect prank call, but Rock bails to watch Franz Roll's pet, Kitty.

Scissors makes it a flat rule to be hardcore, and Paper struggles to follow it. Scissors' therapist is on holiday as Logan the Rat Bro starts bullying him for figure skating, so she refers him to her colleague, Logan.

Jack gets his first phone and immediately sends the wrong text to Will, forcing the kids to do whatever it takes to delete it. When the last Hallasand goes missing, fingers point to Halmoni and only a family tribunal will set the record straight.

When Alvin accuses Dave of yelling at him too much, a therapist moves in to help Dave control his anger. When the school digs up an old high school time capsule, Miss Smith and Dave work together to keep an old secret.

The boys disobey Dave's orders to not play a dangerous game, then have to hide their injuries when they get hurt. The school newspaper has a sudden increase in sales when a gossip column appears poking fun at other students.
A consultant becomes Boss Baby's worst nightmare after arriving at Baby Corp with zany ideas and setting his sights on the CEO's job.
On a trip to Chicago to see Gigi and Grandpa, Boss Baby comes face to face with an ambitious baby masquerading as an adult.
Max flees from Phoebe and Captain Perfect to prove his innocence when he is wrongly accused of committing a crime.
Max pretends to turn evil to infiltrate Mastermind's henchmen and steal the Chip-Chucker, a device that previously turned him evil.
Captain Man attempts to boost his image by holding a contest where three winners get a tour of his secret lair. But Henry's friends are among the winners.
After capturing the Lawnies' attention, SpongeBob and Squidward become a hit new live act. After Cecil stumbles into a pile of underwear, he becomes an underwear salesman.
Cecil and his friends go on a fishing trip at the lake; in a post-apocalyptic future, Bunny competes in a Roller Derby match to save the world.
The boy's imaginations run wild when Dave disappears; when they finally find him, they're convinced he's a zombie; Alvin tries to convince Dave that he's being hunted by a flying beast.
Alvin books the band at a birthday party only to discover they've been booked for the petting zoo as pets; Theodore invents an imaginary friend.

Rock, Paper and Scissors have a great time birdwatching until they return home to find the birds have started watching them; the trio discovers they're trapped in a nightmare and must wake up before one of them wets the bed.

Paper is frustrated when Scissors gets a car registered as an emotional support convertible and brings it with him everywhere. The trio's baseball lands in an air force base, and they must enlist to get it back.

Convinced old people are the new enemy, Boss Baby uses Tim to create havoc, but a war soon begins when the seniors rally against babies. Boss Baby creates an org chart to cement his leadership as the boss of the playgroup babies.
When Baby Corp's lead scientist accidentally turns the stinkless serum into a stink enhancer, Boss Baby needs Tim's help to freshen things up.

After Chloe's birthday party is cancelled, Max and Phoebe compete to throw her a new one. When Max's time-stopping birthday gift falls into the wrong hands, he must work with Phoebe to stop some party poopers from ruining Chloe's birthday.
Phoebe and Max tell holiday stories to compete in the Thundermans Story Slam, but it's Chloe's story that makes them understand the meaning of the holiday.
VMA-winner Alex Warren hosts the slime event of the year, where we celebrate your favourite stars from film, television, music, sports and social media.
Halmoni becomes a master hacker and vows to destroy the internet. Lily must retrieve a book.
Alvin and Brittany wind up in a battle over popping acorn tops and bubble wrap. When a cute girl joins the chess club, Alvin enlists Jeanette to teach him how to play so he can join as well.
We interview Lauren Steadman and head to the NFL London Game at Wembley Stadium to set the fans a challenge.
Dave, Simon and Theodore are worried about Alvin's safety after Alvin enters a karate contest.
Sam notices that Cat has been spending lots of money. When she asks where it's coming from, Cat takes Sam to a 'Magic ATM' that gives her free money, and Sam worries that this might not be legal.

Sam and Cat notice everyone, including their friends, are becoming obsessed with a new phone game, Brain Crush. The game is very distracting, and the audience are not focussed on Cat's one-woman show.
Lay Lay and Sadie volunteer to build houses for those in need, but when Sadie is put in charge of all the workers, managing Lay Lay becomes her biggest challenge.
Trying out for the cheerleading squad, Lay Lay and Sadie add their own twists to the routine, but learn that standing out doesn't always work when trying to fit into a team.
Max is nervous when his girlfriend auditions for the romantic lead opposite a cute boy in the school play, so he convinces Phoebe to audition for the same role.
Henry must juggle work and romance while trying to capture The Mad Granny, who is terrorising Captain Man.
While trying to capture The Mad Granny, who keeps terrorising Captain Man, Henry is forced to juggle his work life and his romantic life.
To increase baby love, Baby Boss schemes to change the local soccer team's name from the Hive to the Babies.
After sneaking into a grown-up movie, Tim decides he's ready for the adult world; Boss Baby sleeps over at a friend's house.

Paper takes the cellphones of Rock and Scissors, so the trio can connect in real life, but it turns out to be the worst day ever. Rock cannot sleep, so Paper and Scissors must tell him a bedtime story, but he is hard to please.
Boss Baby throws a cupcake party to combat low company morale, then sends a manager to help Tim handle some family business.
Rock, Paper and Scissors are three best friends who share a flat together and compete over everything. Week to week, they have tiny problems that always get out of hand.
Plankton has decided to throw in the towel and start a new business selling trinkets and souvenir gifts. Gary starts biting everyone in town, starting with Squidward.

SpongeBob eats sea onion ice cream and his breath stinks. When people avoid him, Pat convinces him that it's because he's ugly. When Mr Krabs gives his daughter Pearl a job at the Krusty Krab, she starts to make some changes.
When Mr Krabs' daughter Pearl is stood up, SpongeBob agrees to step in. Mr Krabs dupes SpongeBob into believing he might break his winning streak and lose to Squidward.
SpongeBob gets a hold of Mermaid Man's utility belt and accidentally shrinks all of Bikini Bottom. Mrs Puff takes the blame for an accident SpongeBob caused and goes to prison.

SpongeBob has failed his driving test, again. Pat is so outraged that he takes the test to prove that it is unfair, only he passes. Patrick discovers in a genealogy document that he is next in line to receive a kingly title.

Everyone is in awe of Larry the Lobster's daredevil ways, especially SpongeBob and Patrick. Everybody who's anybody is going to a big party in Bikini Bottom, but you have to be a certain shade of tan to get in.
SpongeBob and Patrick go back in time to see the young Mermaidman and Barnacleboy. SpongeBob and Patrick watch their heroes fight bad guys in a classic Mermaidman and Barnacleboy episode.
The campers meet two backwoods narwhals named Narlene and Nobby, who treat them to a sweet surprise.
The monsters of camp host a support group; a buried bone unearths a heap of trouble for Sandy.
Narlene and Nobby teach Regigille all about backwoods living; the Trawler cabin creates the perfect camper to compete in the Camp Summer Games.
Annoyed by SpongeBob for the last time, Squidward issues him a restraining order. Plankton steals a Krabby Patty from the Krusty Krab, unaware it's really an art piece by famous artist Fiasco.

When SpongeBob and Patrick think their homes have been sold, they move away, much to Squidward's delight. When fortune cookies start predicting the future, Plankton realises he can twist them to his own evil schemes.

SpongeBob wants to be the first sponge to dive all the way up to the surface of the ocean. When SpongeBob and Squidward accidentally let Plankton steal the secret formula, it's up to them to steal it back.
Patrick's dad unexpectedly visits Kamp Koral. SpongeBob, Patrick and Sandy befriend a visiting ghost camper.

SpongeBob and Patrick find buried treasure at camp, but Mr Krabs becomes desperate to get his claws on it. SpongeBob and Patrick pass Gary off as one of their own to protect him from the wrath of Mrs Puff.
The Krusty Krew builds a boat for their penny-pinching captain. SpongeBob discovers a crazed castaway living in his walls.
Patrick and SpongeBob work at the theatre; under Sandy's guidance, Patrick hosts a science show.
After accidentally putting on doctor's clothes, Patrick believes he's a doctor; after Pearl can no longer have a sleepover with Squidina, the Stars surprise Squidina with a slumber party.
Craig Mammalton learns what it's like to not be the best at something; Patrick and a cake hide out in the wilderness.

Camp Master Krabs finally hires a camp nurse, but she needs to dedicate all her time and effort to keeping SpongeBob safe. When all the campers try to win the "Stinkiest Camp in the Forest" award, Squidward has to fend for his life to stay clean.

When an unsatisfied anchovy strays from his brothers, SpongeBob and Patrick must help him find his true identity. SpongeBob is sent to time-out on behalf of his buddy, so Patrick does what he can to rectify the situation.
Squidward's amazing new life is threatened. Stuck in her dome, Sandy suspects Plankton's up to no good and gets Patrick to investigate.
Patrick hosts an award ceremony; Captain Doug Quasar meets Pat-Tron's robot family.
Grandpa competes for Granny Tentacles' love on a dating game show. The Ice Cream Man and Ice Cream King team up to capture a mysterious ice cream eating beast.
SpongeBob and Patrick are convinced a butterfly ate Sandy's pet caterpillar. SpongeBob's coloured patty sales idea becomes a huge success and Mr. Krabs wants a piece of the pie.
Granny Tentacles helps Squidward collect his paper delivery money from Cecil. The Star family house runs away from home.
Plankton has a new invention that allows him to switch lives with Mr Krabs. When Larry the Lobster is short one man for lifeguard duty, SpongeBob volunteers.
Patrick gets hit in the head and comes to with superior intellect. Sandy accidentally melds SpongeBob and Squidward into one body when her teleportation device malfunctions.
It's Kamp Koral's first ever Wild West Day! SpongeBob and Patrick become vampires for a night.
The Dinghy cabin camps overnight out of the water. Wilderness expert Paul Grunion visits the camp.

Miss Priss, who is against all things fun and delicious, has Krabby Patties banned from Bikini Bottom. When Stanley, SpongeBob's klutzy cousin, comes to visit Bikini Bottom, he quickly turns SpongeBob's life upside down.
Plankton steals Sandy's fur to disguise himself as Sandy and get the Krabby Patty formula. Plankton goes inside SpongeBob's head to get the Krabby Patty formula.
Patrick overstays his welcome at the SquarePants home. GrandPat attempts to injure himself for Nurse Helga's attention.
The Stars' pet toilet Tinkle has puppies; the Star family spends a day playing at the cemetery.
SpongeBob and Patrick learn the secret origins of Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy from the heroes themselves. Plankton grows a second eye using SpongeBob's DNA, and becomes nice.

Pearl gets a job to be cool like her friends, but the only store that's hiring is the lamest store at the mall. SpongeBob loses the use of his thumbs, and must get them back in working order before his entire life falls apart.
SpongeBob, Sandy, and Patrick are split up into separate cabins; Squidward has to earn back his morning "Reveille" duties.

When Nobby becomes too civilised for Narlene, SpongeBob and Patrick help him remember his backwoods ways. Perch and his pal, Harvey, report the news of Kamp Koral, but they stumble upon evidence of a ridiculous conspiracy.
Quasar uses Patrick to communicate with Aliens; Patrick and Grandpa have a contest about staring off.
The Patrick Show gets competing sponsors; the star family visits King Neptune's palace.
SpongeBob builds a pool in his backyard and Squidward tries to resist taking a dip; Mr. Krabs must reckon with the Goobfather after he adds patty whips to the menu.
Two familiar faces from SpongeBob's past visit; Plankton finds an unlikely ally in the sewers.
Squidina has to direct her school holiday play, but her script was mangled by Patrick.
The Star family find themselves getting smaller and smaller. Patrick's evil twin cousin shows up to ruin Patrick's reputation.
The Stars run a Patrick Show theme park in their home. Patrick and Squidina embark on a quest to find the lost bathroom.
SpongeBob and Patrick are sent to jail in the underground tunnels of Glove World, leading to a daring escape.

Sandy struggles to build a ship-in-a-bottle before a big contest, so SpongeBob calls in a little extra help. Plankton goes to jail, but the secret formula is taken as evidence. SpongeBob and Mr Krabs plot to get it back.
Sandy tries to study SpongeBob and Patrick's behaviour, but her science experiment goes horribly awry. Mr. Krabs takes Plankton's advice, and finally marries the only thing he ever loved, money.
Squidward goes home sick with a fake illness. Mrs Puff finally finds a use for SpongeBob's reckless driving and enters him in the Demolition Derby.
When Squidward points out to SpongeBob that he's not normal, SpongeBob makes it his mission to become normal. SpongeBob wakes up one morning to find that everyone in Bikini Bottom is gone, even Gary.
The scariest roller coaster ever has just opened at Bikini Bottom's amusement park. Plankton tricks SpongeBob, Patrick and Squidward into fixing up the Chum Bucket.
Amused at the attention showered on Inspector Blake by new canteen girl Molly, Stan and Jack tease their superior.
After a mix-up with a large freezer Terry decides to leave Arthur's employ and try his hand in the second-hand furniture business.

Auntie Vera has got problems with her hips and defective lifts, so tells Sharon and Tracey she is moving in. There is only one room available though, and a dismayed Dorien is told that family must come first.

Yvonne thinks she may be pregnant. Phoebe wants Gary to go to the country with her for a couple of days to visit her orphaned cousins. An American flyer comes into the picture, and the attraction between him and Phoebe is obvious.

The Ropers need money with which to mend George's old car so they agree to sell Robin their piano, as they never use it. The problem is how to get it upstairs. George's friend Jerry tries to winch it through the upstairs window into the flat.
Host Kenny Everett welcomes musical guests Suzi Quatro and Nick Lowe.
The best music from the 1960s and some forgotten gems. The soundtrack to New Year's Day.
News, interviews and features for Scotland from the last week.
A silly retelling of Robert Louis Stevenson's classic story `Treasure Island'.
Bernard sets class 5C a task, to weigh the school, he believes that this may prepare them for the outside world.
Much to the delight of the school, Miss Ewell appears to have fallen in love and her wonderful good mood is catching.

Gary Sparrow finds his route back to 1941 and alternative sweetheart Phoebe blocked by a new row of shops in 1995. Meanwhile, back in 1941, there's a further complication in the imminent attack on Pearl Harbour.
In the run-up to New Year's Eve, Gary worries about finding a way to see in the New Year with both Phoebe and Yvonne. Then Mrs Bloss threatens to chuck him out of his bedsit.
Gary takes his frustration over the war with Japan out on his wife's possible future employer, a Korean businessman.
Rigsby and Vienna prepare to spend a grouchy, cheap Christmas alone.
Rigsby returns to find two unexpected arrivals, Miss Jones and a baby. However, a baby is against the rules.
When an actor arrives at the house everyone becomes stage-struck, except Rigsby. He says he never trusts a thespian, especially one with rosebud wallpaper.
A not-so-ordinary wedding turns out to be a chaotic event when everything that can possibly go wrong does.
There is a massive epidemic of the flu and many of the bus crews are down with it, which is good news for Stan and Jack as they are making a lot of money out of over-time.
The Annual Busmen's Ball comes round again, and the lads decide they want something a little more exciting this year. So, Jack arranges for a stripper.
Canteen lady Suzy takes pity on Stan and Jack and gives them food to take home. Her good deed is not appreciated, and she is fired. She is replaced by a new canteen attendant who has stricter rules.
Celebrating Ulster-Scots life in Northern Ireland. This week's episode features the Ballyclare May Fair and the Ulster-Scots Broadcast Fund reception. Presented by Shauna Lawson and Chris Finlayson.

It is the first day of the holidays, and the Solana is in chaos, with Mateo and Les/Lesley barely able to keep control. They are waiting for the appearance of new manager Joyce Temple-Savage, but a coachload of angry holidaymakers arrives first. Kenneth is now proprietor of the Solana's new hair salon, and he and Gavin take time to comfort the recently widowed Jacqueline.
The couples decide to take a trip into the mountains.
When Ruth takes up first aid she turns her attention to the invalid in the basement. Rigsby, who's been hoping for the kiss of life for some time, becomes alarmed.

New manager Joyce organises a dance competition for the guests and everyone is eager to take part. Rehearsals are supervised by her old flame Cyril Babcock, an ageing playboy whose impatience with the talentless contestants leads to a dance-off with Mateo. Elsewhere, Kenneth hires an assistant for the salon, but her minimal knowledge of hairdressing and English leads to an unfortunate accident with her first client.
The busmen decide to get fit after reading an article which states that drivers have a shorter life expectancy than conductors.
2 decades of movie moments and classic pop hits from the 70s & 80s. Direct from the red carpet - Limahl is ready for his close-up!
Crackling vinyl, shag carpets & lava lamp glows - this is how we loved in the 70s! Oh, James...
From the era of Glam Rock, New Wave & Disco - it's all the hits from just 1 decade - the 1970s! Platform boots & flares at the ready?
Dodgy dancing, slightly inappropriate flirting, extreme close-ups, chest hair, huge afros and those crazy fashions. Playing 25 songs and videos that could only have been made in the 1970s.
Big singalong choruses and outrageous outfits and make-up, these were the guys and gals that set the style of the 70s, and our man with the musical plan, Tony Blackburn was there!
25 laid-back songs from the first half of the decade - expect long hair, trippy vibes and a few leftover hippies from the 60s!
The voice of your childhood with 30 festive faves especially animated for Christmas! Including Brenda Lee, Beach Boys, Michael Buble, Elvis Presley and The Frog Chorus.
Feel-good hits & festive favourites from just 1 decade - the 1970s! Santa hat, platform boots & tinsel at the ready?
Mark Goodier presents 1970s big music award winners. Find out which superstar singer won at the Oscars at the start of the decade and who got the keys to the City of Indiana.
A music playlist featuring a selection of classic hits spanning the year 1970.
Blimey, what a year! Get ready to turn your telly up LOUD, with the greatest party anthems from 1970 including The Jackson Five, Mungo Jerry, Black Sabbath, Free and Elvis Presley.
A music video playlist presenting the biggest rock and roll rebels of the 1970s, presented by the man who was there for all of it, that groovy host from the West Coast, Radio 1 legend, Rosko.
Turn it up loud for 2 hours of proper rock from the 70s - the decade that gave birth to Prog and Metal! Including Pink Floyd, Led Zeppelin, Black Sabbath, Alice Cooper, AC/DC and Queen.
T'Pau's Carol Decker is back again with a countdown of 80s guys who liked to rock! With John Parr, Billy Idol, Guns N' Roses and ZZ Top.
Classic love songs from the NOW That's What I Call Music archive.
This is the soundtrack to your Christmas festivities - 80s style! Only the big party and singalong tunes back to back!
A fine decade for Christmas chart-toppers of all kinds! Including seasonal favourites from Cliff & Shaky, along with unexpected entries from Pet Shop Boys and Jackie Wilson.
A choice selection of the 191 singles that reached the top of the UK charts in the 1980s!
In order - Mark Goodier's 11-hour journey through the decade's biggest number 1 songs, from ABBA and Adam Ant to Wham!, Madonna, Rick Astley and Kylie Minogue.
Twenty massive UK number one songs all about love and lust! Some happy, some sad, but all of them sung from the heart.
Sixty minutes of back-to-back US chart toppers from 1989 - none of which made the top spot in the UK! Including Bad English, Michael Damian, Martika and New Kids on the Block.
Sixty minutes of back-to-back US chart-toppers from 1987 – none of which made the top spot in the UK! Including U2, Gregory Abbott, Billy Vera and Bob Seger.
Sixty minutes of back to back US chart toppers from 1985 - some you might know well, some you might not! Including Jan Hammer, REO Speedwagon and Ready for the World.
From Peter Frampton and Free to Foreigner and Fleetwood Mac - the 70s was a feelgood and carefree time for pop and rock, and we bring back that vibe with 30 of the absolute best!
Party pop rock anthems spanning 5 decades! From Queen, Kiss & Aerosmith to Blur, Paramore & The White Stripes.

1938 wird der bisher erfolglose Schriftsteller Ian Fleming auch noch in seinem Job als Aktienhändler gefeuert. An diesem Abend trifft er in einem Jazzclub auf die verführerische Ann O'Neill. Im Gegensatz zu seinen bisherigen Eroberungen scheint Ann eine Traumfrau zu sein. Am nächsten Morgen stattet ihm seine dominante Mutter Eve einen Überraschungsbesuch ab, um ihn davon zu überzeugen, für den Chef des Geheimdienstes der Royal Navy zu arbeiten.

1940 befinden sich Ian Fleming, sein Chef Admiral John Godfrey und Leutnant Monday auf neutralem Gebiet in Lissabon. Ian bricht eine Besprechung frühzeitig ab, um zwei Nazis im Kasino des Hotels am Baccara-Tisch herauszufordern. Währenddessen läuft Frankreich Gefahr, vollständig in die Hand der deutschen Besatzer zu fallen. Ian erfährt, dass die französische Flotte durch den Vormarsch der Nazis bedroht ist, und reist nach Frankreich, um die Vernichtung geheimer Dokumente zu überwachen.

Während Ian Fleming ein Alliierten-Ausbildungslager in Kanada besucht, bekommt er vom US-Geheimdienstkoordinator das Kompliment, dass er bei seinem Talent anstelle der Militär-Reports auch Romane schreiben könne. In London will Admiral Godfrey nun Flemings Idee umsetzen, ein Aufklärungskommando aufzubauen.

Der Zweite Weltkrieg kommt langsam zum Ende, jedoch fürchten Ian Fleming und Admiral Godfrey, dass das deutsche Atomprogramm in die Hände der Russen fallen könnte. Ann will sich nach dem Tod ihres Mannes an der Front verheiraten. Sie hofft darauf, dass Ian ihr ein Zeichen seiner wahren Liebe geben wird. Fleming beschließt, Sergeant Dixon nach Tambach zu begleiten, wo das Archiv des Nuklearprogramms der Deutschen versteckt sein soll.

Nach einem Wohltätigkeits-Motorradrennen wird die Leiche eines 19-jährigen Bikers gefunden. Während die Gemeinde trauert, entdecken Geordie und Will schnell Spannungen und Rivalitäten unter den jungen Fahrern.

Dry Aged Beef ist für viele ein Hochgenuss. Daphne de Luxe fragt sich, warum wir Lebensmittel erst feiern, wenn sie aussehen wie aus dem Tatort-Kühlhaus. Ingrid Kühne spricht humorvoll über ein uns allen bekanntes Thema: Vergesslichkeit.

Marie Huber und Georg Leitner haben bei einer Hausgeburt auf der Alm ihr Baby bekommen. In diesem Glücksmoment erhalten die jungen Eltern jedoch eine schreckliche Nachricht: Ihre Väter, Sebastian und Lorenz, sind mit dem Auto tödlich verunglückt.

Die in England geborene Joan Stanley (Judi Dench) studiert in Cambridge Physik und verliebt sich auf dem Campus in den ebenso attraktiven wie manipulativen Leo Galich (Tom Hughes). Durch ihn beginnt Joan das Leben durch einen ganz neuen Blickwinkel zu sehen. Sie wird zu einer Sympathisantin der sowjetischen und kommunistischen Partei und viele Jahre später, während des Zweiten Weltkriegs, als Beamtin der britischen Regierung für ein geheimes Nuklear-Forschungsprojekt angestellt. Dabei erkennt.

Julia Klug kann in letzter Sekunde verhindern, dass zwei Jugendliche ihr Auto knacken und ausräumen. Sie nimmt die Täter fest, den 16-jährigen Marc und seine 14-jährige Schwester Nele. Nele und Marc sind Waisen, die erst seit kurzem in einer Pflegefamilie untergekommen sind. Der alarmierte Pflegevater Klaus Esser bekniet Julia, die Sache nicht an die große Glocke zu hängen. Schließlich befänden sich Nele und Marc in einer schwierigen Phase der Umgewöhnung.

Julias beste Freundin, der Transvestit Karla, ist am Boden zerstört - ihr Imbissstand wurde vom Gesundheitsamt geschlossen. Den Befehl zur Razzia gab niemand anders als Julias Chef: Johannes Sonntag. Julia stellt ihren Chef zur Rede, doch Johannes hat unschlagbare Argumente. Der Polizeipräsident höchstpersönlich und auch die Direktionsleiterin Marei Schiller mussten sich übergeben, nachdem sie an Karlas Stand eine Bratwurst gegessen haben.

Julia wird von Direktionsleiterin Marei Schiller zu einem Anti-Aggressionstraining verdonnert. Ihr Chef Johannes Sonntag ermittelt schon länger gegen eine Bande von Produktpiraten, die gefälschte Armbanduhren, Kettensägen, Hochdruckreiniger und Kinderwagen nach Deutschland importiert. Jetzt soll die Bande hochgenommen werden - aber ohne Julia. Der große Schlag gegen die Produktpiraten geht jedoch daneben.

Julia Klug will ihre Freundin Karla vom Flughafen abholen. Zufällig wird sie Zeugin, wie ein Dieb einer Stewardess einen Koffer entreißt. Julia will den Dieb stellen, der schleudert ihr den Koffer entgegen und entkommt. Beim Aufprall auf den Boden springt der Koffer auf - und eine Unmenge Zwei-Euro-Münzen purzelt auf den Boden, insgesamt mehrere Tausend Euro. Die bestohlene Stewardess ist spurlos verschwunden - maximal ein Fall für die Flughafenpolizei, meint Johannes Sonntag.

Beim morgendlichen Spaziergang mit Ellie an der Spree landet ihr Teddy im Wasser. Mit einem kühnen Sprung rettet Patrick das Stofftier. Doch im Wasser treiben auffallend viele tote Fische. Vorsichtshalber entnimmt Julia Klug eine Wasserprobe. Und Patrick beginnt, sich zu kratzen. Nur wenig später erstattet eine Mutter Anzeige auf der Wache: Ihr Sohn hat sich beim Spielen am Spreeufer eine Vergiftung zugezogen und liegt im Krankenhaus.

Sie begannen mit einem aufsehenerregenden Skandal, machten ihre Liebe, die gegenseitige Anziehung, ihren Streit, den Reichtum und ihre Süchte öffentlich und wurden so zum Glamourpaar der Swinging Sixties: Elizabeth Taylor und Richard Burton. Sie ist seit ihrer Kindheit ein verwöhnter Hollywoodstar, er ist ein walisischer Bergarbeitersohn, der sich zu einem der großen Theatermimen seines Landes entwickelt hatte. Sie begegnen sich am Filmset in Rom.

Die wahre Geschichte des 73-jährigen Rentners Alvin Straight handelt von seinem Roadtrip auf einem Rasenmäher. Er fährt auf diesem 300 Meilen (ca. 483 km), um seinen kranken Bruder, der einen Schlaganfall erlitten hat, im Krankenhaus zu besuchen. Die beiden hatten wegen eines Streits seit zehn Jahren keinen Kontakt mehr miteinander. Nun will Alvin das Kriegsbeil endlich begraben. Seine Reise hält ungewöhnliche Abenteuer für ihn bereit.

Zehn Jahre nach seiner Abreise nach Amerika kehrt Herr Andersens Sohn Paul zurück, um das Erbe seines Vaters mit Stiefmutter Molly zu regeln. Das Überleben des Hotels steht dabei auf dem Spiel. Amanda lernt derweil Dietmars Vorlieben kennen.

Molly Andersen steht unter Druck, das Hotel zu verkaufen. Lydia und Vera versuchen derweil Herrn Andersen zu kontaktieren. Und plötzlich taucht auch Morten wieder auf. Einige weibliche Gäste machen indes ohne ihre Männer einen Ausflug nach Skagen.

Der Kaufmann Damgaard zieht seinen Kredit an Molly zurück. Er möchte das Hotel selber kaufen und seine Frau soll es führen. Stimmt Molly dem Deal zu? Morten kauft sich unterdessen ein Motorrad und Adam hat endlich geheiratet.

Die Saison neigt sich dem Ende zu und die Gäste bereiten sich auf ihre Abreise vor. Die Polizei sucht bei Morten nach einem Schmuggler. Adam taucht auf. Für viele Gäste und Angestellte bahnt sich der Moment der Wahrheit an.

Madsen lädt die Stammgäste zur Nebensaison nochmals ein, nachdem sich seine Investitionen an der Wall Street ausgezahlt haben - so denkt er zumindest. Doch nichts läuft wie geplant, als ein Sturm aufzieht. Amanda und Dittmar haben Neuigkeiten.

Es geht um die Frage, ob Emily Arundel eines natürlichen Todes gestorben ist. Die Frage ist insofern von Bedeutung, als es um ihr Erbe geht. Poirot fühlt sich in der Pflicht, den Fall aufzuklären, da er ihr geraten hat, ihr Testament zu ändern.
Ridley untersucht einen Juwelenraub. Er vermutet, dass es sich um einen Insider-Job handeln könnte.
Eine Mordermittlung führt zu einem Gestüt, einem Drogendealer und einem wohlhabenden Geschäftsmann.

Im Auftrag von Sir Henry Coverly beschattet Mr. Whicher dessen Frau wegen des Verdachts der ehelichen Untreue. Er findet heraus, dass Lady Jane Coverly ein Verhältnis mit Matthew Thorogood hat. Nachdem er Sir Henry Bericht erstattet hat und es zu einem Scheidungstermin vor Gericht kommt, erscheint Matthew Thorogood trotz Vorladung nicht. Als Mr. Whicher der Sache nachgeht, findet er Matthew kurz darauf ermordet im Wald.

WWII in Europe was largely filmed in black and white, but in the Pacific, American cameramen filmed everything in colour. We use their footage to tell the story of the fight for Okinawa, the last great battle of the Pacific War.

Positive climate tipping points; a supercomputer in Cheyenne, Wyo., shows how climate systems are predicted and analysed; a Michigan coal plant makes progress in the transition to renewables; climate challenges and vulnerabilities across the U.S.
Exploring the impacts of climate change on ocean currents in Florida; electrification; nature's role in achieving net-zero emissions.
Exploring the impact of World War II on a small island in the Palau archipelago in Micronesia, a remote island considered the most well-preserved battlefield in the world.
Unique colour footage of American forces during the Second World War in the Pacific, and in defeated Japan.

The political structures of the Japanese Empire allow the military to operate outside the control of the civilian government. This leads to the invasion of Manchuria, and a new view of Japan's destiny emerges.

After the successful attack on Pearl Harbour, the Japanese army begins a widespread assault throughout Asia. The war successes accumulate, Malaysia and Singapore are conquered, then the Philippines and Burma.

In the Japanese-occupied territories, the military rules with extreme harshness. Countless atrocities are committed against the civilian population, but also against prisoners of war. Meanwhile, doubts are growing among the Japanese population.

The overwhelming superiority of the Allies becomes increasingly apparent and comes to its climax in August 1945 with the atomic bombing of the two cities Hiroshima and Nagasaki. This action leads to the surrender of Japan.

Tolkien entwickelt aus den Erfahrungen der Menschheit, aber auch aus seinen eigenen eine eigene, scheinbar bis in die Kriege der Jetzt-Zeit gültige, Mythologie. Als er Der Herr der Ringe schreibt, kämpfen seine Söhne im Zweiten Weltkrieg.

Die Dokumentation, die ausschließlich aus Archivmaterial besteht, erzählt vom Alltag deutscher Zivilisten und Soldaten während des Zweiten Weltkriegs: von seinem Beginn im September 1939 bis zu den Monaten nach der deutschen Kapitulation.

Verschiedene Themen der deutschen und internationalen Zeit- und Kulturgeschichte werden nachgezeichnet. Mit Expertengesprächen und szenischen Nacherzählungen werden dabei Vorkommnisse aus jüngerer und älterer Geschichte neu zum Leben erweckt.

Tierfilmer Rainer Bergomaz und sein indianischer Kollege Yung Sandy begeben sich auf eine Expedition in eines der letzten unerschlossenen Gebiete der Erde, um den Mohrenkaiman zu finden. Bisher weiß man kaum etwas über den großen Bruder des Alligators und das größte Krokodil Südamerikas. Wie alle großen Echsen wurde auch der Mohrenkaiman über Jahrhunderte hinweg erbarmungslos gejagt. So ist seine Art inzwischen stark gefährdet.

Rainer Bergomaz und Yung Sandy überwinden Stromschnellen, Flüsse und Wasserfälle, klettern auf 50 Meter hohe Bäume, kämpfen sich durch Buschwerk und Lianen, um ein Harpyien-Nest zu finden. Harpyien zählen zu den mächtigsten Greifvögeln der Welt. Die seltenen Adler leben in den Regenwäldern Südamerikas. Der Griff ihrer Klauen ist kräftiger als der Biss eines Schäferhundes, ihre Krallen sind länger als die des Grizzlybären.

Weltweit hören wir derzeit vor allem negative Schlagzeilen rund um Urwald-Abholzung und Umwelt-Zerstörung. Doch es gibt auch Hoffnung. Im Norden Argentiniens werden die ersten Jaguare eines besonderen Schutzprojekts ausgewildert.

Ihr ganzes Leben lang kommen weibliche Meeresschildkröten genau zu dem Strand zurück, an dem sie selbst aus dem Ei geschlüpft sind, um ihre eigenen Eier abzulegen. Wenn es den Strand noch gibt, denn immer mehr Strände nutzt der Mensch.

Mal sind sie lustig, mal nervig, mal sexistisch, mal eine Frechheit, Werbespots. Werbung spiegelt immer die Gesellschaft wider, schaut dem Volk gewissermaßen aufs "Maul". Das gilt auch für die Rolle der Frau und ihr Bild in der Werbung.

Informiert wird ausführlich über das politische und gesellschaftliche Geschehen in Deutschland, Europa und der Welt. Neben den Übertragungen wichtiger politischer Ereignisse werden in Gesprächen mit Experten aktuelle Debatten analysiert.

In der Sendung stellt sich eine Persönlichkeit mit interessanter Vita aus Gesellschaft, Kultur, Wirtschaft oder Politik in einem intensiven Gespräch über Hintergründe, Lebensentwürfe und Erfahrungen den Fragen der Moderatoren.

Die wichtigsten Themen und Ereignisse der Woche stehen im Zentrum, die von einer Runde aus Journalisten aus dem In- und Ausland kommentiert werden. Einschätzungen, Statements und Ansichten werden dabei teils kontrovers diskutiert.
Die Diskussionssendung mit wechselnden Themen und Gästen.

Die Folge erweckt die Inspirationen hinter J.R.R. Tolkiens populärer Fantasy-Welt Mittelerde zum Leben. Die große Popularität von Tolkiens Universum ist zeitlos und weltweit verbreitet. Generationen von Lesern sind davon geprägt worden.

Lange ging man davon aus, dass Tolkiens Werk in erster Linie Fantasy sei. Jüngere Forschungen zeigen, wie stark die Weltgeschichte in Mittelerde eingeflossen ist. Vor allem Tolkiens Teilnahme am Ersten Weltkrieg hat zahlreiche Spuren hinterlassen.

Im Jahr 1979 soll Michael Levine, ein Undercover-Agent der US-Drogenbehörde, die Verbreitung der neuen Droge Kokain stoppen. Währenddessen plant der Drogenboss Roberto Suárez mit dem NS-Kriegsverbrecher Klaus Barbie einen Putsch in Bolivien.

Michael Levine und seinen Undercover-Agenten gelingt es, im bolivischen Dschungel eine Tonne Kokain zu beschlagnahmen und einige von Roberto Suárez' Komplizen festzunehmen. Diese sind jedoch schon kurz nach ihrer Verhaftung wieder auf freiem Fuß.

Zur Feier der Machtübernahme über Bolivien schmeißen Roberto Suárez und Klaus Altmann ein großes Fest. Mit der neuen Regierung verdienen sie Milliarden durch den Handel von Drogen. Gegen ihre Gegner gehen sie auf brutale Weise vor.

Jeremy Wade reveals the new deep-sea discoveries that might prove the existence of the infamous giant squid and looks at whether this underwater monster is the legendary kraken.

Discovering how everyday items like dress forms, boat propellers, duvets and taps are made.
More everyday items are put under the microscope as we discover how they are made, including bronze bells, wooden aeroplane propellers, charcoal briquettes and gas log fireplaces.
Drew and Tee visit a salvage yard that specialises in stoneware. Blown away by the quality and rarity of some of the items, Drew is forced to haggle hard by the canny dealer.

The boys visit a heritage railway in Minehead where Drew discovers a fantastic selection of pieces in need of salvaging. The highlight of the trip, however, is a ride in the cab of a vintage steam train.

Drew and Tee get an exclusive look at a private collection of rock 'n' roll memorabilia. Drew is excited to find some very rare Led Zeppelin and Motörhead collectibles and hopes he can strike a bargain.
An old portrait painting could be worth a fortune, and it's a race against time for Irita and her team to identify the famous artist before auction day.
Irita visits the home of a former pop star, where she uncovers a never-before-seen photo of an undressed David Bowie and finds some rare watches.
Angus helps Amanda and Steve clear their late parents' home in Huddersfield that's full to brimming with memories and treasured things.
Shaun asks Angus to clear his late father's home, which is packed with unusual items from East Asia, but some forgotten toys are the stars at auction.

Silversmith Brenton West is tasked with reviving a worn-down singing trophy that celebrates the musical talent of a sadly departed mother. Won in 1955, it commemorates a young girl who turned her back on singing when she started a family. With one handle missing and the silver plate tarnished and dented, the trophy is in bad shape.

Jay Blades and the team bring three treasured family heirlooms, and the memories they hold, back to life. First through the barn doors is Gloria Bartlett. She's brought her pride and joy, a Chesterfield armchair, in the hope that upholstery superstar Sonnaz Norranvary can return it to mint condition. She borrowed the money to pay for two chairs and a sofa in the 1980s and at the time felt very extravagant.

Ceramics expert Kirsten Ramsay is charmed by a series of handmade pottery vegetable patch signs. Emma's father was extremely artistic and spent their childhood making all sorts of remarkable items. He cast and painted these lovely pieces himself and used them to mark out the different sections of his impressive veg patch in their garden. Sadly, he passed away suddenly and after several years of harsh weather, the signs are cracked, faded and won't stand the test of time.

Wood expert Will Kirk is entrusted with a precious toy yacht that holds bittersweet memories for its owner John. The yacht brings back fond memories of playing with his younger brother Michael who died suddenly from meningitis at the age of 14. Now John would love to see it restored to reconnect him to the brother he still sorely misses. Leather expert Suzie Fletcher is tasked with reviving a midwifery bag originally owned by Wendy's grandmother.
Childhood toys and a coin collection need to be sold to pay for a widow's home costs. A downsizing means some risqué art needs to go under the hammer.
Angus needs to sell some wild west costumes. And a widower's unfashionable furniture needs to make big money so he can be reunited with his family.
